title: Hiring! Performance Marketer / Media Buyer - Meta & TikTok
description:
Good day! Glitchy is currently looking for an experienced performance marketer/media buyer who can test new offers, build campaigns from scratch, and find profitable ways to scale them.



A major part of this role is continuously testing new Glitchy offers. You should be able to take an unfamiliar offer, understand how the vertical is currently being run, develop your own testing strategy, launch paid traffic, analyze the results, and make a clear decision on whether to scale, continue testing, or stop.



This is not a campaign-maintenance role. We want someone who can find new angles, creatives, audiences, funnels, and approaches that make offers work.



What We're Looking For



- Strong hands-on paid media buying experience

- Personally launched, managed, optimized, and scaled campaigns

- Strong experience with Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, or both

- Experience managing real advertising budgets

- Proven ability to test new offers, not only optimize established campaigns

- Able to take a new offer and build a test strategy from scratch

- Strong understanding of CPA, CPC, CTR, CVR, ROAS, and profitability

- Strong creative-testing instincts

- Able to develop hooks, angles, and campaign concepts

- Able to interpret performance data and make decisions from it

- Strong budget and spend discipline

- Able to d
 when to kill, continue, or scale a campaign

- Practical understanding of tracking and attribution

- Able to troubleshoot performance independently

- Comfortable working across different products and verticals

- Clear reporting and documentation

- Able to operate without constant direction



You do not need to come specifically from affiliate marketing. What matters is whether you already know how to buy media, test intelligently, control spend, develop testing ideas, diagnose problems, optimize campaigns, and scale winners.



Employment Details

- Full-time

- Long-term position

- Performance-based incentive



How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your resume

2. Which advertising platforms you have personally managed

3. The largest monthly advertising budget you have personally controlled

4. One or two campaigns you personally ran, including the results and what you changed

5. Examples of creatives, landing pages, funnels, or campaigns you worked on, if available

6. A short explanation of how you normally approach testing a completely new offer

title: REAL ESTATE Lead Manager
description:
LOCATION: REMOTE

COMPANY: HBI HOME SOLUTIONS, LLC

POSITION TYPE: FULL-TIME



SALARY:

Base pay range: $6/hr - $9/hr depending on experience level.

Bonus/commission: 1% of net profit per deal, ranging from $150-$750 per deal depending on net profit. Average total bonus/commission is around $750 per month (average 3 closed deal per month at $25,000 net profit each deal)

Total pay range (base + commission) per month: $1200/mo - $2500/mo



OUR COMPANY:

We’re a real estate wholesaling company with main markets in GA & SC with a focus on acquiring deals from Real Estate Agents. We transact about 80-100 deals a year with gross revenue of $1.8M+/year. You can learn more about us and our model through these two podcast videos on Youtube:







RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Build and nurture relationships with real estate agents to buy properties from them. 

2. Conduct outbound cold calls to local real estate agents to start new relationships. 

3. Follow up with existing real estate agents in company database to check if they have any potential deals we can buy.

4. Conduct discovery calls when real estate agents send us new deals to qualify the deals based on motivation, condition, timeline, and price.

5. Support Acquisition Manager with making offers through real estate agents to buy their listings/properties.

6. Support Acquisition Manager with following up on offers previously made to get the properties under contract.

7. Maintain accurate records of calls, appointments, and lead information in the company CRM.



REQUIREMENTS:

1. Fluent in English with minimal accent, capable of clear and effective communication.

2. Minimum 6-month experience in Real Estate Lead Manager/Sales. Experience in comping/underwriting are preferred.

3. Must be able to work minimum 8-hour shift on US Eastern time zone (8-10 AM EST to 5-7 PM EST).

4. Must be able to call 1-2+ hours talk time and send out 20-35 manual texts a day

5. Familiarity with U.S culture preferred.

6. Ability to work independently and efficiently in a remote environment.

7. Strong interpersonal skills with a confident and persuasive demeanor.

8. Excellent time management and organizational skills.

9. Basic knowledge of GoHighLevel is a plus but not required.



BENEFITS:

1. Competitive salary with the opportunity for performance-based bonuses.

2. High potential for career growth and advancement within the company. Once proven skills, can be promoted to Acquisition Manager to increase income potential.

3. Flexible work hours to accommodate other commitments.

4. Ongoing training and support to enhance your skills and maximize your potential.

5. Joining a dynamic and inclusive team dedicated to success in the real estate industry.

title: CCTV Store Monitor / Operations Checker — Australian Dessert Cafe (Home-Based, Long-Term)
description:
Type: Part-time, 3-4 hours per day, 6-7 days per week

Salary: $3 - $5 per hour depending on experience

Hours: Between 1:00 PM and 9:00 PM Philippine time (our café trades 3pm-11pm Melbourne time, only 2 hours ahead of you, no night shift)



About us



We run Munch, a busy dessert café in Melbourne, Australia. We're a growing family business with 10+ staff, a store manager, and plans to open a second store in 2027. We are building a proper management system and you will be a key part of it: our eyes on the store.



The role



You will watch our store's CCTV cameras remotely (view-only access through the camera app) and complete a daily checklist in a Google Sheet. You are checking that our standards are actually happening, every shift, and recording what you see with timestamps.



Daily checks include:



- Staff arrival times: who started on time, who was late (with timestamps)

- Uniform and presentation on shift start

- Opening procedures completed properly and on time

- Task verification: checking that staff complete their assigned tasks for the shift (from the daily task list we provide) and recording what was done, not done, or done late, with timestamps

- Cleanliness of stations during service (screenshot evidence when below standard)

- Closing procedures completed properly



You record facts, not opinions: times, yes/no, screenshots. Your report goes to the owner and store manager each day.



The checklist starts with these checks and will grow as you settle in. As the role matures, it will expand to include:



- Food quality checks: comparing plated products on camera against our photo spec sheets (portioning, presentation, correct build) and flagging items served below standard, with screenshots

- Customer service checks: observing service interactions on camera, including greeting on arrival, speed of service, staff attentiveness, and how complaints or issues are handled, and noting anything below standard with timestamps



Your role can grow with the checklist. We plan to build a controller team as we open more stores, and the first hire trains the next ones.



Who we're looking for



- Extremely detail-oriented and patient. This work rewards focus, not speed

- Honest. You report what you see, even when it's uncomfortable. That's the entire job

- Reliable internet (at least 10 Mbps) and a computer or laptop that can run camera viewing software smoothly

- Good written English for short, clear daily reports

- Available consistently in the afternoon/evening window, long-term. We want someone for years, not months

- CCTV monitoring, quality assurance, or auditing experience is a plus but not required. We will train you on exactly what to check



Home-based is perfect for us. If you are a stay-at-home and prefer steady quiet work from home in a provincial area, this role suits you well.



How to apply



Start your application with the word STRAWBERRY so we know you read this. Then tell us:



- A short paragraph about yourself and your home internet/computer setup

- Any experience with monitoring, QA, auditing, or detail-checking work

- Your available hours (Philippine time) and confirmation you can work most weekends (our busiest days are Friday-Sunday)

- Your expected hourly rate

We are a UK brand and digital design studio working with B2B and B2C businesses across two core areas: brand and rebrand projects, and website design. All designs are produced in Figma.

The studio operates as a solo practice. The Founder handles strategy, concepts, creative direction and client relationships himself, and now needs a senior designer to take on the execution so he can stay focused on the creative direction rather than the rollout.

Concepts, brand direction and client sign-off are handled by the Founder; the Remote Specialist develops that approved direction into complete, polished sites. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

-Explaining design decisions clearly and ﬂagging problems early

-Developing brand collateral and marketing materials once direction has been approved.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 



Advanced Figma skills - Auto Layout, components, variants and structured, reusable design systems (non-negotiable)

Senior-level experience as a web or digital designer

Excellent UI and UX skills, with a strong grasp of responsive behaviour, navigation and user journeys

A high standard of visual design - typography, hierarchy, spacing, and the ability to turn a brand into a distinctive website

E-commerce design experience, particularly Shopify (strongly preferred)

Brand and identity design experience (bonus, not essential)

A portfolio of website work with a clear account of what they personally contributed

Genuine independence - able to progress work between reviews without hand-holding

Easygoing and collaborative - open to feedback and straightforward to work with

A strong communicator in written and spoken English

Quality-first - both speed and quality matter, but quality takes priority

Own reliable equipment and internet connection



SOFTWARE AND TOOLS 

Figma · Google Workspace · Slack

title: Logistics Order Entry and Tracking Coordinator
description:
1099 CONTRACTED ORDER ENTRY & TRACKING COORDINATOR — ROLE OUTLINE

1. Position Summary



A contracted logistics professional responsible for entering orders accurately, coordinating appointments, obtaining critical shipment details, and proactively tracking freight from pickup through delivery. This role serves as the operational backbone behind timely, precise, and transparent freight execution.



2. Minimum Requirements



3–5+ years of experience in logistics, transportation, or freight operations.





Proven ability to build orders, schedule appointments, and interface with shippers, consignees, and carriers.





Strong history of handling multiple tasks simultaneously without letting details slip.





Impeccable English — spoken and written — with clear, professional communication.





Must already be familiar with TMS platforms, load-entry workflows, and appointment-setting procedures.





Must be comfortable working independently with accountability, accuracy, and urgency.







3. Technical & Security Requirements



Ability and willingness to use a dedicated VPN or Remote Desktop for all work activities.





Must work through a remote desktop environment (company-controlled workstation).





Must maintain the confidentiality of client data, carrier information, and all internal systems.





Stable high-speed internet, backup connectivity, and a quiet, professional work environment.







4. Work Schedule



Must be available on Eastern Time





Standard hours: 7:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST (Monday–Friday)





Occasional off-hour coordination based on shipment needs is expected — this is logistics, and the clock doesn’t always cooperate.







5. Core Responsibilities



Order Entry

Accurately enter orders into the TMS with complete shipment details.





Verify dimensions, weights, accessorials, equipment type, and special requirements.





Ensure all instructions are precise and documented to prevent downstream errors.





Appointment Coordination

Contact shippers, receivers, warehouses, and carriers to gather all critical load details.





Schedule pickup and delivery appointments with clear confirmation and follow-up.





Proactively obtain any missing information required to keep timelines intact.





Tracking & Communication

Track all shipments from tender to delivery, providing real-time updates.





Flag delays, risks, or issues early — no surprises.





Maintain clear communication with internal team and external partners.





Documentation & Accuracy

Upload PODs, BOLs, rate confirmations, and supporting documents.





Double-check data accuracy to avoid billing mistakes or service failures.





Maintain organized digital records with consistent naming conventions.





Problem Solving

Resolve appointment conflicts, accessorial issues, and missed information quickly.





Ask the extra question to prevent problems before they become emergencies.







6. Performance Expectations



High accuracy in order entry and documentation.





Zero tolerance for miscommunication or missing details.





Professional, timely, and proactive communication.





Ability to remain steady during chaos — logistics rewards those who stay composed.





Treat every shipment like someone is waiting on it… because they are.







7. Contract Structure



1099 Independent Contractor status.





Must provide their own equipment, connectivity, and VPN compatibility.





Paid weekly or bi-weekly based on agreed structure.





Performance may influence increased workload or long-term contract extension.

title: Lead List Building & Operations Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



FlowLead runs cold
 and LinkedIn outbound campaigns for a growing group of clients. We are hiring a detail-oriented, technically comfortable person to take ownership of our lead-list-building operation.



Your main responsibility will be building accurate B2B lead lists. You will learn each client's target market, create different search approaches, review lead quality, and prepare lists for our outbound campaigns. As you master the process, the role may expand into other marketing and operational responsibilities.



THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS ROLE



We need someone who can think independently and critically.



After training, you should be able to understand the goal, test possible solutions, troubleshoot problems, and make reasonable decisions without needing every task broken into exact steps. You should ask questions when something genuinely needs clarification, but first make a real effort to investigate and solve the problem yourself.



This role is not a good fit for someone who needs to be repeatedly reminded what to do or who waits for detailed instructions whenever something changes.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Learn the targeting rules for each client.

- Build cold
 and LinkedIn lead lists using AI Ark, Apollo, and approved supporting tools.

- Turn a client's target market into multiple useful search strategies.

- Use different combinations of filters and signals instead of blindly copying one search.

- Review samples to make sure the companies and contacts fit the client.

- Export, combine, organize, and deliver completed lists accurately.

- Run the required lead-history checks and AI-personalization steps.

- Track completed work and communicate genuine blockers early.

- Troubleshoot tools and processes before asking for help.

- Gradually take on additional marketing or operational responsibilities as the role develops.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- B2B lead-generation, prospecting, research, or list-building experience.

- Strong critical thinking and independent problem-solving.

- Comfortable learning new software and technical workflows.

- Experience with tools such as Apollo, Sales Navigator, Clay, AI tools, spreadsheets, CSV files, or similar platforms.

- Able to explain why a search or lead matches the client's target market.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Fluent written and spoken English.

- Honest about errors and willing to correct them.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and backup plan.

- Interested in a long-term position.



SCHEDULE AND PAY



- Full time, Monday-Friday.

- 11:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. Eastern European Time.

- Starting pay: $500 USD per month, paid as two $250 payments.

- Compensation reviews after 90 days, six months, and annually.

- Disclose any current jobs, clients, businesses, school, or recurring commitments before hiring. They must not interfere with this schedule or your work for FlowLead.



HOW TO APPLY - STEP 1



Do not send a video yet. Start by sending a short written application that answers these questions:



1. What country and time zone are you located in?

2. Can you consistently work Monday-Friday from 11:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. Eastern European Time?

3. What experience do you have building B2B lead lists or performing prospect research?

4. Which prospecting, spreadsheet, AI, and other technical tools have you used?

5. How do you determine whether a company and a contact match a client's target market?

6. Tell me about a time you had to solve a work problem independently. What did you do before asking for help?

7. Is the $500 USD monthly starting pay acceptable?

8. Attach your resume or provide a link to it.



Please give specific, honest answers. Generic or copied answers will not help us evaluate you.



HIRING PROCESS



1. We review your written answers.

2. Selected applicants receive more detailed questions to answer in a short video.

3. Applicants who pass the video step complete a practical list-building assignment.

4. Final candidates join a video call with us.



You will not receive client data or production access during the hiring process.

title: Tutorial Content Producer (Scriptwriter + Screen Recorder)
description:
We run YouTube channels focused on software and AI tool tutorials, reviews & comparisons. We're looking for a Content Producer to research, script, and record our step-by-step videos.



We need a minimum of 8 videos per month, about 2 per week on a steady schedule (not all at once at the end of the month). Videos are typically 8-12 minutes long. Topics include how-to tutorials, tool reviews, and tool comparisons.



HOW IT WORKS:

I send you a short brief on a topic/tool. You test the tool yourself, write out the exact steps, write the video script, and record clean screen footage of the process. You submit everything to our review team, who pass it on to the editors.



You will not need to record your voice or appear on camera. Voiceovers and avatars are handled separately.



YOU WILL:

- Read a brief and learn the tool or topic quickly

- Test the process yourself and write accurate, numbered steps

- Write a clear, natural, easy-to-followscript for each video

- Record high-quality screen footage that matches the script (clean cursor, steady pace, correct resolution)

- Flag anything in the brief that is wrong, outdated, or doesn't work as described

- Follow our script template, naming conventions, and submission process

- Fix issues sent back in review quickly



REQUIREMENTS:

- Strong written English (this is the most important skill for the role)

- Experience with screen recording software (OBS, Loom, Camtasia, or similar)

- Comfortable learning new software and AI tools quickly

- Attention to detail: every step must work exactly as written

- Reliable internet and a computer that can record smoothly at 1080p or higher

- Able to meet deadlines and communicate proactively

- 
 account for communication



NICE TO HAVE:

- Previous tutorial, how-to, or YouTube content experience

- Experience with AI tools or SaaS software



WORKING SETUP:

- We will provide access to any paid tools you need for testing and recording.

- Each brief comes with a deadline (usually 3 days). Hours are flexible, but you must be reachable on 
 and respond within a day.



PAY:

$25 per video that passes review, with a guaranteed minimum of 8 videos per month. We're looking to scale, and there will be more work available for the right person. Rates for additional volume will be discussed once we get there. Top performers get first access to extra work, plus a path into a senior or QA role.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully, applications that skip this will not be reviewed):

Start your message with the word PRODUCER, then answer these:

1. Link to a tutorial, script, or screen recording you made (or describe one if you can't share it).

2. What screen recording tool do you use, and at what resolution do you record?

3. You test a step from a brief and it doesn't work. What do you do?

4. How long does a tutorial like this typically take you from brief to finished footage?

5. What timezone are you in and what hours are you available?



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short screening task, and finalists will complete a paid trial.

title: Simpro & Xero Admin, Quoting & Invoicing VA | Fire Protection/Trade Services
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with strong, hands-on Simpro and Xero experience will be prioritised for this role.



A fire protection services business needs a full-time Virtual Assistant to take on Simpro-based administrative and invoicing work, freeing the onshore admin team to focus on higher-value, revenue-generating activity — most notably following up the AU$100k–300k of quotes going out weekly, which currently go largely unchased. The role centres on Simpro housekeeping, quoting support, sub-contractor invoice processing, and records management, with accounts receivable follow-up (resending invoices/statements via Simpro and Xero, not direct phone-based customer contact at this stage) as part of the scope.



Success looks like a VA who can independently run the repeatable, high-volume Simpro tasks accurately and consistently, freeing the admin team — and eventually management — to spend their time on client relationships, quoting new sites, and higher-value decisions. This is intended as a repeatable model: if it works, the same approach gets built into how the business (and future acquisitions) structure admin work going forward.



What You'll Own



Simpro Job & Data Management



Review and correct naming conventions on new jobs (daily/monthly)

Update access and contact notes on new jobs (daily/monthly)

Job card review

Folder creation in Attachments against each site

Auditing of jobs to assist management as required

Client records review/overhaul (Simpro & SharePoint)



Quoting



Standard defect quoting

Quote follow-ups (weekly, using scripts)



Invoicing, Purchasing & Accounts



Process sub-contractor invoices — daily, from the service inbox (Simpro & Outlook)

Process sub-contractor invoices — monthly, from the service inbox (Simpro & Outlook)

Raise purchase orders for monthly service works

Accounts receivable follow-up as directed (Simpro & Xero) — resending outstanding invoices/statements; not direct phone-based customer contact at this stage



Client & Site Communication



Send
s to clients to update site contacts, access details, and account contact details (names,
s, phone numbers)



Records & Compliance Management



Records management of internal/external logsheets and service reports

Auditing of employee records to follow up licences

Updating supplier catalogues as required



What We're Looking For



Experience



Prior experience in an admin, invoicing, or quoting support role — ideally within a trades, maintenance, or field-services business

Fire protection, compliance, or building services background is a plus but not essential



Technical Proficiency (Core Requirements)



Simpro: required — strong, hands-on, working experience is essential. This business runs the highest-tier "Lightning Edition," and Simpro is the core operating system for job management, quoting, invoicing, and internal task-based communication

Xero: required — confident, hands-on experience is essential, particularly for accounts receivable follow-up and reconciling against Simpro-generated invoicing

Comfortable with basic Microsoft 365/SharePoint use

Comfortable working from mobile-app-generated field data (technician-logged defects, hours, materials) rather than a clean handed-off brief



Organisational Skills



High attention to detail across a genuinely high-volume workload (800–1,000 jobs/month across 20 staff)

Able to juggle several live threads — quoting, invoicing, records, AR follow-up — without letting any slip



Non-Negotiables



Process documentation is roughly 50% complete already — the VA will still be expected to build out the remaining SOPs as they learn, using a shadow-and-document approach

Proactive communicator who flags uncertainty early rather than guessing

Comfortable operating within a structured communication style: morning priorities message, end-of-day summary
, weekly check-ins

No formal fire industry background required; general trades/maintenance exposure helps

Comfortable slotting into a recently-rebuilt, younger, tech-savvy team culture that's positive but still maturing its internal systems and accountability structures

Comfortable with ambiguity early on — day one/week one task sequencing isn't fully finalised yet, and the VA will need to adapt as scope firms up in the first weeks



Why This Role



Genuine ownership of a high-volume, high-value function ($100–300k/week in quotes) within a growing business

Put deep Simpro and Xero skills to work at the centre of the role, not as a side task

A structured, supportive communication rhythm rather than being left to guess

Real opportunity to shape a repeatable admin model that could extend across future business acquisitions

Join a friendly, easygoing team culture that's still maturing its systems — a chance to help build, not just follow



How to Apply

title: DM Appointment Setter — Australian Women's Health & Fitness Coaching (PCOS/PMOS), Remote, Part-Time to Start
description:
About us. NE Coaching is an Australian-based coaching business helping women with PCOS/PMOS lose weight and manage their symptoms through training and nutrition coaching — without a rigid or restrictive approach. We market through Instagram and most of our leads reach us by direct message. Our audience spans Australia, the UK and the US. Remote, fast-paced, zero-drama.



About the role. We're hiring a DM Appointment Setter to manage conversations with new followers and inbound leads, and book qualified prospects onto a call with the coach. This is a conversation role, not a sales role — the coach handles the sale. Full training and onboarding provided. Starting part-time with room to grow as volume increases.



Responsibilities. Open a conversation with every new follower using our provided script. Qualify each prospect with a warm, curious tone and record the outcome in our lead tracker. Book qualified prospects onto the coach's calendar, coordinating call times across timezones. Follow up on prospects who've gone quiet, without being pushy. Answer basic questions about the program. Provide a daily output report and meet weekly targets.



Requirements. Fluent written and spoken English — assessed on a recorded video. A working understanding of Western/Australian-UK culture and tone. An interest in health, fitness and women's wellness. Comfortable on Instagram and able to learn a simple lead tracker. Reliable internet and equipment. Open to daily feedback in the first month. Prior appointment-setting experience is an advantage, not a requirement.



Compensation. $6 AUD per hour to start, paid weekly, moving to $10 AUD/hour at three months if things are going well. Plus a performance bonus of $100 AUD for every ten sales signed in a calendar month from calls you personally booked.



Schedule. ~20 hours per week to start, across 6 days — suggested split to cover both AU business hours and UK morning overlap: 9am–12pm and 4pm–8pm AEST (Brisbane time).



To apply. Apply through this listing. Begin your reply with the words DM SETTER in capitals so we know you've read the full ad, and in two or three sentences tell us why you want this particular role. Shortlisted applicants will be asked to record a short video answering six questions, followed by a role-play test, before any interview. Replies that don't begin with DM SETTER won't be reviewed.

title: AI Growth Builder & Outbound Marketer (we build our own): property tech + new SaaS, remote
description:
AI Growth Builder and Outbound Marketer (global outreach), remote



The short version

We are a European property-tech group, and we are building something bigger. We need someone who uses AI to reach the right people in every market and turns that reach into real action on our platforms: agents listing their properties and getting viewings booked, agencies coming on board. Think AI-driven
, AI calling, and social outreach that gets people to like and share, country by country, in the local language. Important: we build and own our systems. We are not looking for someone who rents a pile of subscriptions, we want someone who builds the engine with us so we own it and reuse it. On top of that, you can pick up the broader marketing work too: content, social, basic SEO, paid, analytics.



Who we are

We run several live rental and property platforms in the European market on one shared codebase, plus a new SaaS for the staffing and recruitment sector. We move fast, we test thoroughly, and we reward people who prove results.



How we work (important)

- We build and own our tools. We prefer building over renting. Less vendor lock-in, more control, and everything we build we reuse across our platforms.

- That means working at the level of APIs, your own scripts, and your own automations, not clicking together a stack of expensive closed services.

- You build it once, we own it, and it keeps paying off across every channel and every country.



What you will do (the core)

- Build AI-powered, multi-channel outreach that we own and that scales worldwide, market by market:
 at volume, AI calling, social, and WhatsApp where it fits.

- For the property platform: reach real estate agents in every market and bring them onto the platform, listing their properties and getting viewings booked. The AI calls and messages carry one clear call to action: visit the site and get started.

- For the SaaS: reach staffing and recruitment agencies and get them on board and active in the same way.

- It is one engine for both products. You build it once and it runs for property and for staffing, country by country.

- Make it work in any language. Build a reliable localization approach so the outreach reads native in each market, using AI translation with quality control and native review where it matters. Rough machine translation does not cut it; the message has to feel local, not foreign.

- Drive social amplification: get agents and agencies to follow, like, and share our content, so reach compounds.

- Build the lead data, sequences, and automations yourself, and keep them deliverable and legal in every market you touch: GDPR in Europe, anti-spam laws such as CAN-SPAM, and local rules on
 and automated calling. Warmed domains, clear opt-out, and consent where it is required. Compliance and deliverability are part of the job, not an afterthought.

- Measure everything: replies, signups, activations, and double down on what works.



What you will do (the bonus, all-round)

- Content and social management, basic SEO, paid campaigns, simple design, reporting.



How you build it (we like builders, not renters)

- Comfortable wiring up LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) in your own workflows.

- Comfortable with self-hostable automation (for example n8n) and your own scripts over closed SaaS where it makes sense.

- Can build your own lead data, localization, and outreach pipeline instead of depending on one paid platform.

- For AI calling, you wire telephony and voice models yourself rather than relying on a closed black box.

If you already build your own automations instead of renting them, tell us. That is exactly who we want.



Who you are

- You think in systems and you build and own them.

- You have grown something real and can show it, with a number.

- You are comfortable with volume, testing, and iteration.

- You write clear English, and you have a proven way to make outreach read natively in many other languages (AI localization with quality control, native review where it matters). You do not rely on rough machine translation.

- You respect the law in each country you reach into, and you treat compliance as part of doing it well, not a brake. You know that automated calling in particular is tightly regulated and you handle it carefully, market by market.

- You are self-starting and reliable, and you keep brands safe (no spammy shortcuts that get domains blacklisted).



The deal

- Remote, full-time preferred. We start at a fair entry rate and raise it quickly for people who prove results.

- We test with a small paid task first, then move fast for the right person.

- As we scale this across both products and more markets, there is room for it to grow into more than one role.



How to apply (please read)

1. Start your message with the word GROWTH so I know you read this.

2. In a few lines, answer this: how would you reach 10,000 real estate agents in one country using AI, end to end, how would you keep it legal and deliverable there (think GDPR, anti-spam, and rules on automated calling), how would you make the outreach read natively in that country's language, and which parts would you build yourself versus rent?

3. Add one example of something you have grown, with a number.

Applications that skip these get less attention. We reply to serious ones quickly.

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property/SaaS-tech, remote)
description:
Role

We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



How we work

We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

title: Airbnb STR Remote Virtual Assistant
description:
We are seeking an experienced Virtual Assistant to support the day-to-day operations of our fast-growing short-term rental management company. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role focused on guest communication, cleaning and maintenance coordination, administrative support, and timely completion of operational tasks.



The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable handling multiple properties and competing priorities. You will be expected to take ownership of assigned tasks from start to finish, resolve routine issues independently, and communicate clearly when additional support or approval is needed.



Work Schedule

- Full-time, fully remote: 40 scheduled hours per week, 8 hours per day. 

- Flexible with shift schedules: Morning shift: 8am - 4pm, Evening shift: 4pm - 12am, Admin shift: 10am - 6pm. 

- You must be flexible with all the shift schedules, including weekends. The schedule follows U.S. Pacific Time.



Note that all assigned work must be completed personally. Delegating or outsourcing work to sub-VAs or other individuals is strictly prohibited.





Key Responsibilities

Guest Communication & Reservation Support

- Respond promptly and professionally to guest inquiries through Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, direct-booking channels,
, and phone.

- Support guests throughout their stay, including booking inquiries, check-in instructions, access issues, amenity questions, and checkout.

- Resolve routine guest concerns and complaints within established policies and approval limits. Escalate urgent, sensitive, or high-cost issues with a clear summary and recommended next steps.

- Review reservation details, calendars, and special requests to identify potential issues and ensure accurate information.

- Assist with guest reviews, damage claims, disputes, and platform support cases by gathering documentation and following up.



Cleaning, Maintenance & Vendor Coordination

- Coordinate cleaning schedules and confirm that properties are ready before guest arrival.

- Follow up with cleaners on completion status, turnover photos, missing supplies, and reported property issues.

- Contact and coordinate with maintenance technicians, handymen, landscapers, and other service providers.

- Source vendors, request quotes, confirm availability, and arrange approved services.

- Track cleaning and maintenance issues through completion, verify that the work has been completed, and keep relevant parties informed.



Administrative & Listing Support

- Create and update property listings, descriptions, photos, amenities, house rules, and check-in instructions as assigned.

- Maintain accurate property information, guest records, vendor contacts, and operational documentation.

- Complete assigned updates in Hostaway, PriceLabs, and OTA platforms according to established procedures.

- Monitor listing alerts, guest feedback, and account notifications; flag issues promptly and complete required follow-up.

- Assist with property onboarding and setup on additional booking channels by organizing information and completing assigned configuration tasks.



Task Ownership & Operational Follow-Through

- Manage your assigned inboxes, tickets, and task queues, prioritizing time-sensitive guest and property issues.

- Take ownership of tasks from initial request through confirmed resolution—not just forwarding messages or creating tickets.

- Maintain clear notes on actions taken, current status, deadlines, and next steps so others can follow the work without unnecessary back-and-forth.

- Provide end-of-shift updates covering completed tasks, unresolved issues, pending approvals, and follow-up needs.

- Follow company SOPs, flag gaps or recurring problems, and suggest practical improvements based on day-to-day experience.





Qualifications

- Proven hands-on experience supporting short-term rentals on Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, or similar platforms.

- Familiarity with STR PMS.

- Excellent written and spoken English, including confidence communicating with guests and vendors by phone.

- Experience coordinating cleaning, maintenance, or other property-related services.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple properties, conversations, and deadlines.

- Sound judgment and problem-solving skills: able to handle routine issues independently, recognize urgency, and know when to escalate.

- Proactive, reliable, and accountable, with a strong habit of following up without repeated reminders.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and learning new software, tools, and procedures.

- Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable computer and headset, and a quiet workspace for guest and vendor calls.

- Ability to consistently work the required Pacific Time schedule and provide the stated standby availability.

How to Apply



Growth Opportunity

Top-performing Virtual Assistants may have the opportunity to advance into a VA Manager role as the company grows.



Please submit your application and complete every question in the application form. Only applicants who complete the full form will be considered.

title: Pre-Press Graphic Designer — Apparel Mockups & DTF Artwork
description:
**Pre-Press Graphic Designer — Apparel Mockups & DTF Artwork**



**Company:** Thread Traders  

**Location:** Remote — Philippines  

**Hours:** Full-time, 38 hours per week, Monday to Friday  

**Salary:** PHP 40,000–50,000 per month, depending on relevant experience and skills  

**Schedule:** Agreed working hours with overlap during Australian business hours



**About the role**



Thread Traders is looking for an experienced, detail-oriented Pre-Press Graphic Designer to create professional apparel mockups and prepare production-ready artwork for Direct-to-Film (DTF) printing.



You’ll take customer logos, designs and briefs through to clear approval proofs and accurate final artwork. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys preparing artwork, solving file issues and getting the details right before a job reaches production.



We’re looking for approximately 3–5 years of relevant graphic design or pre-press experience, including practical experience preparing artwork for apparel printing. Embroidery digitising and screen-print artwork setup would be a bonus.



**What you’ll do**



- Create professional garment mockups showing artwork placement, print dimensions and garment colours.

- Prepare customer approval proofs and complete revisions accurately.

- Review incoming artwork and identify anything that needs fixing before production.

- Clean up logos and images, remove backgrounds and redraw or vectorise artwork where appropriate.

- Prepare DTF artwork at the correct dimensions, resolution, transparency and file format, following our production specifications.

- Check fine details, small text, edges and transparency for potential printing issues.

- Prepare DTF gang sheets where required, checking spacing, quantities and layout.

- Follow our colour-management and white-ink requirements, working with production to resolve artwork issues.

- Check that final production files match the approved proof and order details.

- Keep source files, proofs and production exports organised with clear file names and version control.

- Manage your artwork queue, meet agreed deadlines and communicate early when information is missing or a job needs clarification.

- Where your skills allow, assist with embroidery digitising and screen-print artwork setup.



**What we’re looking for**



- Approximately 3–5 years of experience in graphic design, pre-press or print production.

- Demonstrated experience preparing artwork for DTF printing.

- Strong Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop skills.

- Confidence working with vector and raster artwork.

- A sound understanding of artwork sizing, resolution, transparency and print-file preparation.

- Experience creating apparel mockups and customer approval proofs.

- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to check your own work.

- Clear written English and reliable communication.

- The ability to manage multiple jobs and work independently.

- A suitable computer, reliable internet connection and availability for 38 hours per week.



**Bonus skills**



- **Embroidery digitising:** Preparing production-ready stitch files, with an understanding of stitch types, density, underlay, pull compensation and different garment fabrics.

- **Screen-print artwork setup:** Preparing colour separations, spot colours, trapping, underbases and halftones.

- DTF gang-sheet preparation.

- Familiarity with RIP software and white-underbase settings.

- Preparing DTF halftones and handling artwork with gradients or partial transparency.

- Experience working with Australian apparel or printing businesses.

- Experience using order-management systems or shared artwork queues.



Embroidery digitising and screen-print setup skills are valued, but are not essential. Strong apparel mockup and DTF artwork preparation skills are the priority.



**What success looks like**



Your mockups are clear and accurate, your production files match approved artwork, and jobs move through the artwork stage on time. You spot problems before they reach printing, maintain organised files and keep the team informed when something needs clarification.



**What we offer**



- A full-time remote role, working 38 hours per week.

- Monthly pay of PHP 40,000–50,000, depending on your relevant experience and skills.

- The opportunity to apply your technical and creative skills across a range of apparel artwork.

- A short, paid practical assessment for shortlisted applicants.



**How to apply**



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph with:



1. A short introduction outlining your relevant experience.

2. Your CV and a portfolio with 3–5 relevant examples of apparel mockups, artwork cleanups or print-ready files. Only share work you have permission to disclose.

3. A brief explanation of your DTF experience, including the software you use and the checks you complete before releasing artwork for print.

4. Details of any embroidery digitising or screen-print setup experience, including software used and relevant examples.

5. Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

6. Your availability, earliest start date and preferred working hours in Philippine time.



Use **“Thread Traders — Pre-Press Designer”** as your application subject.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a short, paid practical assessment covering an apparel mockup and DTF artwork preparation.

title: Full-Time Video Editor for Meta Ads — Realistic AI Avatars + Real Footage (Spanish)
description:
We're looking for an experienced video editor who has already edited ads for Meta and knows how to work with AI generation tools. You'll be producing our ads — edits with real footage and AI-generated ads, all in Spanish — on an ongoing, long-term basis.



Who we are. A pet health brand. We sell online, direct to the customer, in Mexico and to the Spanish-speaking audience in the United States. Video is what grows the business, so this role isn't a side task: it's a core part of the team.



The bar: AI that doesn't look like AI. A good part of this job is realistic avatars, and realistic means realistic — a person filmed on a real phone. Consistent face and teeth across every shot, natural lighting, natural lip sync, zero artifacts. If your AI work looks like AI work, this isn't the role for you.



HOURS



This is a full-time role: 35-40 hours a week, Monday to Friday.



We start you at 5 hours a day (25 hrs/week) for the first few weeks while you settle in: getting to know our product, our customer, and our standard for what we approve, plus our workflow and our tools.



Once we see the pace and the quality are there — usually within one or two weeks — we move to full days. We bring it up ourselves; you don't have to ask.



WHAT THIS JOB GIVES YOU



You always know what you need to achieve. We give you the script or the reference ad, the angle, and what we need that week. How you solve it visually is your call. We review and tell you what to change and why — never a "not feeling it" with nothing behind it.



You get paid every week, on time. Weekly payments, no delays, nothing to chase. You know exactly when your money arrives.



Your schedule is yours. Work from wherever you want, at whatever hours suit you. No fixed schedule, no sitting online waiting for messages, no explaining breaks. The only thing we look at is whether the work arrives on time and done right.



Steady hours, every week. We need ads constantly, month after month. This doesn't end after three videos. You can plan your year around these hours.



You're part of the team, not an outside vendor. We talk daily and we reply fast. If something isn't clear, say so before you start editing: we'd rather solve it in two minutes than revise the video three times. No layers, no bureaucracy, no waiting three days for someone to approve something.



WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



Most of the time, you'll be working from a reference ad. We send you an ad that's already working and you adapt it to our product and our customer. It's not copying it shot for shot: it's understanding why that ad works and rebuilding it with our footage, our message, and our audience.



You'll also make variations of our own ads that are already winning. Usually changing the hook, the avatar, the voice, the gender of the speaker, the sound, or the CTA — the rest of the ad stays exactly as it is, because that's the part that already works. It's fast, repetitive work, but it demands precision: one careless change can break an ad that was performing.



And other times you'll start from a script of ours and bring it to life yourself. Here the work is visual: what the text says has to be seen on screen. If the voiceover talks about a problem, the viewer sees it; if it mentions the product, it appears. The script is the base, but the visuals are your call.



If an ad needs a clip we don't have, you find it. On social media, in stock libraries, wherever — or you generate it with AI if it doesn't exist. Part of the job is solving with what's available and knowing where to find what's missing. That said: nothing with watermarks, other brands' logos, or recognizable faces of third parties. If you're unsure whether a clip can be used, ask before you build with it.



In all cases you'll work with two kinds of material:



Real footage. Shot footage, UGC, product images, and material we send you. Editing, pacing, captions, on-screen text, and sound.



AI-generated. Realistic avatars, Spanish voiceover, and generated clips, when the ad calls for it.



Plus: syncing Spanish audio precisely and delivering to our Drive, organized and correctly named.



TOOLS



CapCut and/or Adobe Premiere — required

Higgsfield for AI generation (avatars, clips, voice). If you don't know it, we'll teach you and we pay for it. What you do need is real experience with AI-generated video and the judgment to know when a result works and when it needs redoing.

Google Drive for delivery



REQUIREMENTS



-Proven experience editing short-form ads (Meta, TikTok, or Reels)

-Strong command of CapCut and/or Premiere: pacing, captions, on-screen text, sound

-Previous experience with AI-generated video

-Resourceful with material: you know where to find clips and images, and when it's faster to generate them with AI than to search for them

-An ear for Spanish audio: syncing captions precisely and catching when a voice sounds wrong or is out of sync. You don't need to speak Spanish, but you do need to read it and notice when something is off.

-Clear communication in English: you tell us when you start and finish your day, you reply quickly during your working hours, you ask when something isn't clear, and if you're not going to hit the agreed volume in a given week, you say so in advance

-Reliable computer and internet



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your message with the word AROVEN, so we know you read this far.

2. Send your portfolio.

3. Also send 2-3 links to ads you edited yourself, telling us which parts were yours. If you have examples with real footage and with AI, send one of each.

4. Send us one UGC-style ad you made with an AI avatar — a person talking to camera, not animation or voiceover over stock clips. This is the closest thing to what you'd be doing here, so it's the piece we'll look at hardest. If you don't have one, say so.

5. Pick one of those ads and explain why you think it worked well.

6. Tell us what you think matters most in making an ad work.

7. Tell us which AI tools you've worked with.

8. Tell us about your current situation: whether you're working with other clients or companies right now, and whether you can commit to full-time hours with us.

9. Tell us how long you lasted in your last two editing jobs and why they ended.



Applications that don't follow all nine steps won't be read. Everyone who's a fit will hear from us within the next few days with the next steps.

title: Content Creator Feedback Manager (Review TikTok, Reels and YT Shorts) — $1,000–$1,200/month + Bonuses
description:
Salary: Start at $800 a month + performance-based bonuses (TOTAL: $1,000–$1,200 a month once trained)

Senior CFMs earn $1,500+ after 6–12 months.



Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.



ABOUT US



Young Publisher – 



We are an international digital marketing company working with content creators and online brands. The company has over 85 employees around the world. We've been in the industry since 2019. We're currently serving over 1,000+ high-ticket clients per year.



We provide an 80% done-for-you content and monetization system that helps creators grow, go viral, and turn views into income using short-form content, AI tools, and proven strategies. Our clients are typically beginners or early-stage creators looking to build their brand, gain followers, and generate income online.



We focus on structure, accountability, and long-term growth.

We focus strongly on client delivery and producing client results.



BENEFITS



- Full-time position: 7.5 hours daily, Monday-Friday; 37.5 hours a week

- Flexible schedule: Choose your own hours, as long as you show up for the daily meeting (MANDATORY)

- Stable income: Long-term role with regular, on-time payments

- Supportive team: Collaborative environment without micromanagement

- Growth path: Opportunities to increase responsibilities and earnings

- 100% remote: Work-from-home setup



TASKS



Content & Client Feedback



- Review 50-100 short-form client videos (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) per day in our Slack feedback channel -before they are published

- Give constructive, actionable feedback on hooks (verbal/headline/visual), scripting, pacing, editing, and CTA, making sure each client knows exactly how to improve

- Cross-reference each piece of content with client niche, experience, and goals as outlined in their files

- Review previous feedback to ensure consistency and avoid contradictions

- Quality-control content ideas created by our Content Research Experts before delivery to the client, ensuring fit with niche, experience, and likely performance

- Oversee workload balance among Content Research Experts and make sure no one on the team is overloaded or underutilized

- Respond to client questions or tech issues in Slack within 24 hours

- Be tough but fair—only approve content that meets quality standards



Progress Tracking



- Complete daily End-of-Day (EOD) reports

- Attend daily team meeting (mandatory, 3pm CET)

- Keep internal feedback and client progress records up to date



REQUIREMENTS (MUST-HAVE)



- C1+ English (written), with perfect grammar and clear, professional responses

- Significant experience creating or reviewing short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts

- Organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable internet and a quiet, professional home workspace

- Accountability mindset and deadline commitment

- Long-term commitment, eager to master a workflow and have direct impact on client success



BONUS SKILLS (NOT REQUIRED)



- Experience supporting creators and social media beginners, especially ages 45+

- Familiarity with AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, etc.

- Strong understanding of trends/strategy for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts



WHY JOIN US?



- Monthly Performance Bonuses: Rewarding high-quality feedback, consistent task completion, and strong teamwork.

- Fully Covered Software: Access to all necessary premium tools and software provided.

- Great Work-Life Balance: Sustainable hours with no graveyard shifts.

- Professional Growth: Accelerate your skill set through regular feedback and advanced training.



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form to apply: 
/to/O40RINeW



Important note: Put "CFM" + [Your Name & Family Name] in the "Name" field in the form.

title: High-Ticket Account Manager | US Clients - $1,500–$2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property-tech, remote)
description:
Title:

AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property-tech, remote)



Role

We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



How we work

We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.
