title: Senior Accountant – U.S. Accounting Firm
description:
About Roger Advisory Services



Roger Advisory Services is a growing U.S.-based accounting, tax, and advisory firm headquartered in Florida.



We provide bookkeeping, payroll, tax compliance, tax preparation support, and Fractional CFO services to clients in industries including restaurants, real estate, professional services, dental practices, retail businesses, and nonprofit organizations.



We are looking for an experienced Senior Accountant to join our accounting team remotely on a full-time basis.

This is not a basic virtual bookkeeping or data-entry position.



We need an accountant who understands U.S. accounting, payroll, financial statements, balance sheets, compliance deadlines, QuickBooks Desktop, QuickBooks Online, and modern AI tools—and who can work independently after training.



What You Will Be Responsible For



The Senior Accountant will handle accounting responsibilities for multiple U.S. business clients, including:

-Full-cycle bookkeeping

-Bank and credit-card reconciliations

-Month-end and year-end close

-General-ledger review

-Balance-sheet reconciliations

-Balance-sheet cleanup

-Financial-statement preparation and review

-Journal entries and adjusting entries

-Accounts payable and accounts receivable

-Payroll processing

-Payroll setup in QuickBooks Desktop

-Payroll-accounting entries

-Payroll-liability reconciliation

-Payroll-tax adjustments and corrections

-Federal and state payroll compliance

-Sales-tax preparation and filings

-Florida sales tax

-New York sales tax

-1099 preparation

-Accounting cleanup projects

-Preparing client books for tax preparation

-Maintaining accounting documentation

-Managing recurring deadlines through ClickUp

-Working with our CFO and accounting associates

-QuickBooks Desktop to QuickBooks Online migrations

-Using ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools for accounting research, problem-solving, analysis, and financial reporting

-Assisting the CFO with financial-report presentations, management summaries, and client-facing financial analysis



U.S. Tax & Accounting Knowledge



You will not initially be responsible for preparing income-tax returns; however, you must understand how bookkeeping ultimately flows into U.S. tax returns.



Candidates should understand the accounting fundamentals associated with:

-Form 1120S – S Corporations

-Form 1065 – Partnerships

-Form 1120 – C Corporations

-Schedule C – Sole Proprietorships

-Schedule E – Rental Real Estate



Future opportunities may include greater involvement in tax preparation depending on your experience and performance.



QuickBooks Desktop Experience Is Mandatory



We specifically need someone with strong QuickBooks Desktop experience.



You should be comfortable with more than transaction entry.



-You must understand:

-Company setup

-Chart-of-accounts structure

-Payroll setup

-Employee setup

-Payroll processing

-Payroll liabilities

-Journal entries

-Financial statements

-Balance-sheet cleanup

-Bank reconciliations

-Troubleshooting accounting discrepancies

-Historical corrections

-QuickBooks Desktop to QuickBooks Online conversions

-Strong QuickBooks Online experience is also required.



AI & Technology Experience



Roger Advisory Services believes accountants should know how to combine strong accounting fundamentals with modern technology.



Experience with ChatGPT and Claude is strongly preferred.



We are particularly interested in accountants who know how to use AI effectively for:



-Researching complex accounting questions

-Investigating unusual account balances

-Brainstorming possible causes of reconciliation discrepancies

-Researching payroll-tax and sales-tax issues

-Reviewing financial trends

-Analyzing financial statements

-Developing management-report commentary

-Creating executive financial summaries

-Assisting with financial-report presentations

-Turning accounting data into clear explanations for business owners

-Improving SOPs, workflows, checklists, and internal controls

-Supporting the CFO with financial analysis



Candidates should understand the difference between using AI intelligently and blindly accepting AI-generated answers.

All accounting conclusions, calculations, tax information, and recommendations must be independently reviewed and verified before being relied upon.



Required Qualifications

-Minimum 5 years of accounting experience

-Significant experience working with U.S. companies

-Previous experience with a U.S. accounting, bookkeeping, tax, or CPA firm strongly preferred

-Advanced QuickBooks Desktop experience

-Advanced QuickBooks Online experience

-Strong knowledge of U.S. accounting principles

-Strong balance-sheet knowledge

-Payroll-accounting experience

-Payroll-tax knowledge

-Month-end close experience

-Financial-statement preparation experience

-Ability to independently investigate accounting discrepancies

-Experience managing multiple clients simultaneously

-Strong organizational skills

-Excellent written and spoken English

-Excellent professional communication

-Strong attention to detail

-Ability to meet deadlines without continuous reminders

-Ability to work independently after training

-Ability to collaborate with a CFO and other accounting associates

-Comfortable using ClickUp or similar task-management systems

-Comfortable using ChatGPT, Claude, and other modern productivity tools



CPA, EA, or equivalent professional accounting credentials are strongly preferred.

Exceptional candidates without a professional license may be considered if they have substantial experience working in a U.S. accounting or CPA firm.



Work Schedule

This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position, Monday through Friday.

The employee may perform part of the work during their local daytime hours; however, there must be a minimum of four working hours each day that overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Regular communication with our Florida team is required.



First 30 Days

The first month will focus on:

-Learning our clients

-Understanding our accounting procedures

-Learning our ClickUp workflows

-Understanding our review standards

-Learning how our team uses AI and technology

-Working with our CFO and accounting team

-Demonstrating technical accounting ability

-Demonstrating reliability and organization



Initially, client communication will remain primarily with firm leadership.

After approximately 30 days, once the accountant demonstrates strong technical knowledge and understanding of our systems, direct client communication will become part of the role.



After the Initial Period

The Senior Accountant will be expected to communicate professionally with clients regarding:

-Missing documents

-Bank and credit-card information

-Bookkeeping questions

-Payroll questions

-Transaction clarification

-Outstanding accounting items

-Reconciliation discrepancies

-Financial-reporting questions

-Other information required to complete accounting work

-Strong spoken and written English is therefore essential.



The Type of Accountant We Want

We are not looking for someone who waits for instructions for every task.

We want someone who thinks like an accountant and uses technology intelligently.

When an account does not reconcile, investigate it.

When a balance-sheet balance looks unusual, question it.

When payroll liabilities are incorrect, determine why.

When documentation is missing, follow up.

When a deadline is approaching, take ownership of it.

When a complex accounting problem arises, use your accounting knowledge first and leverage tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to accelerate research, explore potential solutions, and organize your analysis.

Then verify the answer before acting on it.

Our firm has systems, recurring deadlines, ClickUp workflows, a CFO, accounting support, and modern AI tools.

We will train you on how Roger Advisory Services operates.

We will not, however, continuously retrain someone on fundamental accounting responsibilities.



Career Growth

This is intended to be a long-term position.

Strong performers will have opportunities to:

-Manage their own portfolio of U.S. accounting clients

-Work more closely with our CFO

-Participate in client meetings

-Assist with higher-level financial reporting

-Prepare financial-analysis presentations and management reports

-Help train or review junior bookkeeping staff

-Become involved in tax-return preparation

-Participate in Fractional CFO engagements

-Grow into a larger accounting-management role as the firm expands



Compensation

$1,800–$2,200 USD per month, depending on U.S. accounting experience, credentials, QuickBooks expertise, communication skills, AI proficiency, and technical ability.



Exceptional CPA-level candidates with significant U.S. accounting-firm experience and advanced payroll, QuickBooks Desktop, AI, and client-management experience may be considered at a higher compensation level.



To Apply

Please send:

-Your resume

-A brief introduction

-A 1–2 minute voice introduction

-Your expected monthly compensation



Please also answer the following questions:

1. How many years have you worked with U.S. accounting clients?

2. Have you worked directly for a U.S. accounting or CPA firm?

3. Rate your QuickBooks Desktop experience from 1–10 and explain what you have personally done in QBD.

4. Have you personally set up payroll in QuickBooks Desktop?

5. Have you reconciled payroll liabilities and corrected payroll-accounting errors?

6. What U.S. payroll-tax filings are you familiar with?

7. What experience do you have with Florida or New York sales tax?

8. Explain how you would investigate a balance-sheet account that has carried an unexplained balance for several months.

9. Describe how you currently use ChatGPT or Claude professionally.

10. Give an example of how you have used—or would use—AI to resolve a complex accounting issue.

11. How would you verify that an accounting answer provided by ChatGPT or Claude is correct before using it for a client?

12. Have you ever used AI to help create a financial report, financial analysis, CFO presentation, or executive summary?

13. Are you able to work full time with at least four hours of daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time?



Applications that do not answer these questions will not be considered.

Bonus Points For:

title: Digital Marketing Specialist – Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads and SEO
description:
# Digital Marketing Specialist – Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads and SEO



**Full-time remote role | Philippines-based | AUD $1,500 per month**



## About 3D Walkabout



3D Walkabout is an Australian technology and digital services company providing 3D scanning, BIM/CAD modelling, architectural visualisation, animation and extended reality solutions.



We operate nationally across Australia and work with clients ranging from architects and construction companies to major national brands. We are also launching new SaaS platforms within VR training and 3D scanning data management.



We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist based in the Philippines to manage and improve our paid advertising campaigns and support our organic search strategy.



This is a hands-on role. The successful candidate will work under our Head of Marketing and Growth and take day-to-day responsibility for running and optimising our campaigns.



## Primary responsibilities



### Paid advertising



* Manage Google Ads campaigns across Search, Display and remarketing.

* Manage Microsoft Advertising campaigns.

* Manage LinkedIn advertising campaigns, including lead-generation and retargeting campaigns.

* Monitor search terms, keywords, negative keywords, audiences, bids and budgets.

* Test campaign structures, advertisements, landing pages and targeting.

* Identify wasted expenditure and opportunities to improve campaign performance.

* Manage conversion tracking and troubleshoot tracking issues.

* Allocate advertising budgets based on performance and commercial priorities.

* Produce clear weekly and monthly reports.

* Focus on qualified enquiries and sales opportunities rather than simply generating clicks or low-quality leads.



Our advertising accounts and campaigns are already established. The initial priority will be understanding the existing setup, reviewing historical performance and making measured improvements without unnecessarily disrupting campaigns that are working.



### SEO and organic search



* Conduct keyword and competitor research.

* Improve on-page SEO across our websites and landing pages.

* Prepare content briefs based on genuine search opportunities.

* Review technical SEO issues and work with our web team to address them.

* Improve internal linking, metadata, page structure and website content.

* Monitor rankings, organic traffic, enquiries and conversions.

* Identify appropriate and reputable backlink opportunities.

* Support local and national search visibility across Australia.



## Required experience



The strongest requirement for this position is practical experience managing paid advertising campaigns.



Applicants should have:



* At least three years of hands-on Google Ads experience.

* Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets.

* Strong Google Search campaign experience.

* Experience with Microsoft Advertising.

* Experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager.

* A good understanding of conversion tracking and attribution.

* Experience using Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager.

* The ability to analyse campaign data and make commercially sensible decisions.

* Strong written English and clear communication skills.

* Good organisation and attention to detail.

* The ability to work independently and take responsibility for results.



Please do not apply if your experience is mainly theoretical, based only on completing courses, or limited to assisting another campaign manager.



Preferred skills



The following would be valuable but are not all essential:



Technical and on-page SEO experience.

Experience with HubSpot CRM and HubSpot marketing tools.

Looker Studio reporting and dashboard creation.

Landing-page optimisation and conversion-rate optimisation.

WordPress experience.

Basic copywriting for advertisements and landing pages.

Experience briefing designers or preparing simple campaign creative.

B2B lead-generation experience.

Experience marketing professional services, technology or SaaS products.

Familiarity with Apollo or similar outreach platforms.

Understanding of account-based marketing and enterprise audience targeting.

Relevant Google Ads or Microsoft Advertising certifications.

AI search optimisation



We are also interested in candidates who understand how search is changing through ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Microsoft Copilot and other AI-powered platforms.



Experience in any of the following would be an advantage:



Generative engine optimisation or AI search optimisation.

Structuring website content so it can be understood and referenced by AI search tools.

Schema markup and structured data.

Entity-based SEO and building brand authority.

Monitoring visibility across traditional and AI-generated search results.

Using AI tools responsibly for research, analysis, reporting and content development.



We do not expect applicants to be experts in an area that is still developing. However, we want someone who actively follows these changes and can help us test practical ways of improving our visibility.



How the role will work



You will report to our Head of Marketing and Growth and work with our existing marketing, sales and website teams.



The Head of Marketing and Growth will determine the overall strategy, priorities and budgets. You will be responsible for day-to-day campaign management, optimisation, reporting and SEO implementation.



Some overlap with Australian business hours will be required. We are based in Western Australia, which is in the same time zone as the Philippines for part of the year and one hour behind during the remainder.



This is intended to be a stable, long-term position with an established and growing Australian company.



Performance measures



Your performance will be assessed using commercial outcomes, including:



Qualified enquiries generated.

Cost per qualified enquiry.

Conversion from enquiry to quotation and sale.

Revenue and gross profit attributed to paid campaigns.

Return on advertising expenditure.

Reduction in wasted advertising spend.

Organic search visibility and qualified organic enquiries.

Accuracy and clarity of campaign reporting.



Clicks, impressions and website traffic are useful supporting metrics, but they are not the primary measure of success.



Please include the following in your application:



A brief summary of your experience with Google Ads, Microsoft Ads and LinkedIn Ads.

The approximate monthly advertising budgets you have personally managed.

Two examples of campaigns you improved, including the problem, what you changed and the measurable result.

An example of a campaign that did not perform as expected and how you responded.

Details of your SEO experience.

Any experience you have with AI search optimisation, AEO or generative engine optimisation.

The analytics, tracking, CRM and reporting platforms you have used.

A short video introduction explaining why you believe you are suited to the role.

In nine years we've guided more than 3,000 families across Singapore, Southeast Asia and the Middle East, and we hold a 4.9 customer service rating. Our founder has personally visited every international school on the island.



We're growing, and we're hiring our first dedicated remote administrator.



The role

You'll be the person who makes the schedule work. School visits are the heart of what we do — a family flies in, and over two or three days they see the schools on their shortlist. Getting that right means coordinating school admissions offices, parents who are often still in another country, and a founder who is usually in a car somewhere between campuses.



Crucially, you will also be a key point of contact for our Mandarin-speaking families and partners, helping bridge communication gaps and providing seamless support.



You'll also research international schools online — fees, curricula, admissions timelines, facilities, waitlists — and write it up so it's genuinely usable.



This is a full-time, long-term remote role working Philippine business hours, which are the same as Singapore hours. No night shift, ever.



What you'll be doing

Mandarin Communication & Support: Handle inquiries,
s, and phone/chat communications with Mandarin-speaking families and partners.



Scheduling and Coordination: Coordinate school visits with admissions teams across Singapore.



Outbound Calling: Make outbound calls to schools and families to arrange, confirm, and follow up on appointments (we provide the calling system — you won't be paying for international calls).



Calendar Management: Build and protect the daily calendar, including realistic travel time between campuses.



Inbox Management: Manage the inbox — triaging, drafting, and sending professional
s to schools, families, and partners in both English and Mandarin.



Research: Research international schools online and write clear, structured summaries.



Knowledge Base: Keeping our school knowledge base accurate and current.



CRM Management: Maintain records in HubSpot — contacts, deals, activity logs, and follow-up tasks.



Document Preparation: Prepare family profiles and shortlist documents ahead of consultations.



General Admin: Provide general administrative support as the business grows.



What you're looking for

Bilingual Proficiency: Fluent and professional spoken and written proficiency in both English and Mandarin (Chinese).



Proactive: You notice the thing that's about to go wrong and fix it before it does. This matters to us more than years on a CV.



Confident on the phone: A real part of this job is calling school admissions offices and speaking on behalf of ED-SG. You need clear spoken communication and the confidence to call someone you don't know.



Excellent written communication: You'll be
ing schools and families directly, unsupervised, in both English and Mandarin.



Quick with technology: New system, no manual — you work it out.



Comfortable with AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar and keen to use them to work faster. This is genuinely part of how we operate, not a buzzword on a job ad.



Strong with Google Workspace: Gmail, Google Calendar, Docs, Sheets.



CRM experience: Ideally HubSpot, or able to learn it quickly.



Organised under pressure: Able to think on your feet when a school reschedules at short notice.



Detail-focused: A wrong time or the wrong campus costs a family a morning they flew in for.



Nice to have

Previous experience working directly with an overseas client (Singapore, Australia, UK, US)



Background in education, relocation, travel, real estate, or another appointment-heavy service business



Familiarity with international schools or the expat relocation world



Home office requirements

Reliable internet, minimum 25 Mbps, with a backup connection (mobile data or second provider)



Backup power arrangement for brownouts



Own computer, headset and a quiet space suitable for professional calls



The details

Type: Independent contractor, full-time, long-term



Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00am – 5:00pm Philippine time



Location: Remote, anywhere in the Philippines



Rate: ₱45,000 – ₱60,000 per month, depending on experience



Paid: Monthly via Wise



Start: As soon as the right person is available



Why work with us

We're a small, growing company, so this role will grow too. The person who takes it on and runs with it can expect to take on more over time — process ownership, client-facing work, and helping build the team as we expand. You'll work directly with the founder and see the whole business, not one narrow slice of it. We're looking for someone to stay and grow with us, not to fill a seat for six months.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Overview

We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented Executive Personal Assistant (EA) to support the client, a senior advisor whose time is split between board/advisory duties, an active luxury watch collecting hobby, and a growing YouTube channel and website dedicated to watch reviews and commentary. The EA is the central point of coordination across the client's calendar, correspondence, travel, and the small team of freelance creatives (video editor, thumbnail/YouTube specialist) who support his content projects. This role requires discretion, strong written English, comfort working across time zones (client is frequently based in or traveling to Israel and other regions), and genuine interest in — or willingness to learn — the luxury watch space.



Calendar, Travel & Meeting Support

Manage and proactively review the client's calendar; confirm meeting details a day ahead and flag conflicts or missing information before they become last-minute issues.

Coordinate international travel (multi-city/multi-country trips, e.g. Europe) including flights, accommodations, and detailed itineraries built around watch events, boutique visits, and business meetings.

Track and pre-confirm meeting details directly with external parties when the client references a conversation or contact that hasn't yet been shared with the EA, to avoid mixed-up expectations.



Communications & Correspondence

Monitor and manage Outlook inbox; draft, send, and track replies, escalating anything sensitive or ambiguous before responding.

Serve as a discreet liaison between the client and stakeholders — board contacts, boutique/dealer contacts, freelance collaborators, and personal contacts — adjusting tone appropriately for each.

Make outbound calls to watch boutiques and dealers internationally (e.g. via Viber Out or similar) to inquire about specific pieces the client is looking to acquire, and track/report call costs for billing.



YouTube Channel & Content Coordination

Act as the coordination hub between the client, his  video editor, and the thumbnail/description specialist — organizing shared drive folders, routing footage and revisions, and keeping the weekly upload cadence on track.

Attend the recurring production/status call with the video editor, and relay direction, feedback, and any equipment or audio-quality issues between the client and the editor.

Maintain organized folder structures (raw footage, edited videos ready for review, final takes, thumbnails) so nothing is lost between contributors.



LinkedIn & Written Content

Manage the client's LinkedIn presence: review and lightly edit articles he drafts (removing AI-sounding phrasing/artifacts per his preference), add cover images and supporting visuals, and publish on a regular cadence.

Monitor article/post performance where possible and flag which topics and formats perform best.

Handle LinkedIn messages and comments per the client's preferences, consulting him before replying where the account or topic is sensitive.



Watch Collecting & Personal Projects

Research and reach out to boutiques and dealers worldwide regarding specific watches the client wants to acquire; track availability, pricing, and follow-ups.

Support other personal projects and errands tied to the collecting hobby (customization requests, provenance/authentication research, event bookings) as they arise.



Technology & Reporting

Provide basic tech support and setup help (primarily Outlook), and flag/troubleshoot recurring issues (e.g. recording/audio equipment settings).

Support exploration and upkeep of AI tools the client wants incorporated into his workflow (e.g. a Claude-based workspace setup), including keeping prompts and configurations updated — this complements rather than replaces the EA role.

Submit a short end-of-week report summarizing completed tasks and any open items.





Schedule & Availability

Approx. 10–15 hours per week, structured around the client's needs; hours can flex up with advance notice and are billed accordingly.

Monday–Friday coverage, with light on-call availability for time-sensitive scheduling changes or confirmations.

Because the client collaborates with teams and contacts in Israel, availability to check and action scheduling items on Sundays is required (Israel's start of work week).





Requirements

Prior experience as an Executive/Personal Assistant, ideally supporting a senior executive, advisor, or entrepreneur.

Strong written English and comfort drafting or lightly editing articles/LinkedIn posts.

Excellent organizational skills and follow-through — able to coordinate multiple freelancers and moving pieces without things falling through the cracks.

Working proficiency with Outlook (calendar and
); comfortable picking up new tools quickly, including AI-assisted workflows.

Highest level of discretion when handling personal, financial, or sensitive information.

Comfortable making international calls to boutiques/vendors on the client's behalf.





Nice to Have

Genuine interest in or knowledge of luxury watches or the luxury goods market.

Experience coordinating with video editors, designers, or other creative freelancers.

Background supporting C-suite hospital executives or investment/medical-field leadership — the client's prior career and several ongoing connections are in the hospital/medical investment space.

title: Full-Time Invoicing Specialist – Australian Plumbing & Electrical Company
description:
# FULL-TIME INVOICER



**Australian Plumbing & Electrical Group | Work From Home**



**Full-time | Long-term WFH**

**Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–4:00 PM PHT/AWST**

**Salary: P80,000 

**Engagement: Direct Philippine contractor**

**Start: ASAP**



## ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for a **full-time Invoicer** to join our growing Australian plumbing and electrical group.



This is **not an Accounts Receivable position, collections role or general bookkeeping role**.



Your primary responsibility will be to ensure that completed plumbing and electrical jobs are reviewed, prepared and invoiced **accurately, professionally and promptly every day**.



Our business operates using **Ascora field-service management software**.



You do **not** need to already be an Ascora expert.



We will train you in how we use Ascora, our invoicing procedures, our customers, our pricing structures and the way our plumbing and electrical technicians record their work.



What is important is that you are highly accurate, comfortable learning software, confident reading job information and able to identify when something does not look right before an invoice is issued.



You will work closely with our Australian operations team and technicians to make sure completed jobs do not remain sitting uninvoiced because information is missing.



## WHO WE ARE



Our group includes **Plumbing Bros West Coast, Electrical Bros West Coast and Plumbing Bros Melbourne**, with further growth planned.



Our teams provide plumbing and electrical services to property managers, businesses and residential customers across Australia.



We have a high-challenge, high-support culture. We set clear expectations, hold each other accountable and provide our team with the systems, training and support required to succeed.



Our five values are:



* Teamwork

* Accountability

* Integrity

* Communication

* Continuous Improvement



We are looking for someone who takes pride in accuracy, communicates when something is unclear and follows jobs through until they are genuinely ready to invoice.



## WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT?



This is not simple data entry.



Every plumbing and electrical job is different.



You will need to review information such as:



* Technician job notes

* Labour and attendance times

* Materials used

* Supplier invoices and purchase orders

* Call-out charges

* Travel charges

* Quoted works

* Approved variations

* Photos and supporting documentation

* Customer-specific pricing

* Agency or trade rates

* GST

* Job history and previous attendances



You will learn how to interpret this information inside **Ascora** and convert it into a clear, professional customer invoice.



If information is missing or inconsistent, your role is not to guess.



You will identify the issue, communicate with the relevant operations team member or technician and get the information required so the job can be invoiced correctly.



## YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



### Daily Job Invoicing



Your primary responsibility will be invoicing completed jobs across our plumbing and electrical businesses.



You will:



* Review completed jobs in **Ascora** throughout the day

* Prepare and issue customer invoices promptly

* Review technician job notes before invoicing

* Check technician labour and attendance times

* Review materials charged to each job

* Review purchase orders and supplier costs where applicable

* Check required mark-ups have been applied correctly

* Apply the correct call-out, labour, travel and service charges

* Check quoted jobs against the approved quote

* Identify additional works or variations that may need approval before invoicing

* Confirm GST has been applied correctly

* Confirm the invoice is being raised under the correct business entity

* Ensure customer and property information is correct

* Check photographs and supporting job information where required

* Identify jobs where notes are unclear or incomplete

* Follow up the operations team or technician for missing information

* Ensure invoices are clear and easy for customers and property managers to understand

* Ensure completed jobs are not unnecessarily left sitting uninvoiced



### Invoice Quality Control



Accuracy is extremely important in this role.



Before sending an invoice, you will be expected to check:



* Are the labour hours reasonable based on the technician's attendance?

* Have the correct rates been used?

* Have all materials been captured?

* Are purchase orders attached to the correct job?

* Have materials been marked up correctly?

* Does the invoice match the approved quote where applicable?

* Have any additional works been properly documented?

* Is the description of works professional and customer-ready?

* Are the technician notes sufficient to support the invoice?

* Is this a first attendance, return attendance or callback?

* Are any discounts or customer-specific rates applicable?

* Is anything unusual that should be queried before the invoice is issued?



You will be trained in our pricing structures and internal invoicing standards.



## ASCORA SOFTWARE



**Ascora will be the main software used in this position.**



If you have previously used Ascora, that will be highly regarded, but it is **not mandatory**.



We are prepared to train the right person.



You will learn how our team uses Ascora for:



* Jobs and work orders

* Technician job notes

* Labour entries

* Materials

* Purchase orders

* Supplier costs

* Quotes

* Job history

* Customer and property information

* Invoicing

* Supporting photographs and documents



Experience with other field-service platforms such as **SimPRO, ServiceM8, AroFlo or similar software** would also be beneficial.



You must be comfortable learning new software and becoming highly proficient in the system.



## WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



To be successful, you should have:



* Previous invoicing, billing, accounts administration or similar experience

* Excellent attention to detail

* Strong written English

* Confidence working with numbers

* Strong computer skills

* The ability to learn new software quickly

* Experience reviewing supporting documents before raising invoices

* Confidence identifying missing or inconsistent information

* The ability to work through a high volume of completed jobs without sacrificing accuracy

* Strong organisational skills

* The ability to communicate clearly with an Australian operations team

* A willingness to ask questions rather than make assumptions

* The ability to follow documented processes and pricing rules

* A reliable home working environment

* Reliable computer equipment and internet connection



## HIGHLY REGARDED



Experience in any of the following will be advantageous:



* Ascora

* SimPRO

* ServiceM8

* AroFlo

* Plumbing businesses

* Electrical businesses

* Australian trades or construction businesses

* Property maintenance

* Real estate or property management invoicing

* High-volume job invoicing

* Reviewing technician timesheets or job cards

* Purchase orders and supplier invoices

* Australian GST

* Microsoft Outlook and Excel



## YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS



### First 30 Days



Your first month will focus heavily on training.



You will learn:



* How our businesses operate

* How to navigate Ascora

* Our different customer types

* Our invoicing templates

* Plumbing and electrical terminology

* Our standard rates and pricing

* How technicians enter job information

* How materials and purchase orders flow through jobs

* How to identify missing information

* When to escalate an invoice for review



Accuracy will be more important than speed while you are learning.



### By 60 Days



We expect you to be confidently processing a significant portion of completed jobs independently.



You should be:



* Comfortable navigating Ascora

* Identifying common invoicing issues

* Applying our standard rates correctly

* Following up missing information

* Producing professional customer-ready invoices

* Developing a strong understanding of our plumbing and electrical workflows



### By 90 Days



We expect you to be taking reliable ownership of the daily invoicing workflow.



Completed jobs should be reviewed promptly, invoicing issues should be identified early and there should be clear reasons for any job that cannot yet be invoiced.



## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



The successful person will:



* Keep completed-job invoicing current

* Produce accurate invoices

* Reduce invoicing errors and credits

* Catch missing labour or materials before invoices are issued

* Identify unusual charges before they become customer issues

* Follow up missing job information quickly

* Learn Ascora thoroughly

* Understand our different customer pricing structures

* Produce invoices that are professional and easy to understand

* Communicate problems early

* Take ownership of jobs that require clarification

* Follow jobs through until they are ready to invoice

* Continuously improve their understanding of our business



## WHAT WE OFFER



* Stable Monday-to-Friday Australian day-shift hours

* Long-term full-time work

* Work-from-home arrangement

* Direct employment relationship with an Australian business group

* Full training in **Ascora**

* Training in Australian plumbing and electrical invoicing

* Clear processes, pricing structures and invoicing standards

* Direct support from our Australian operations team

* A role where accuracy and performance are recognised

* The opportunity to develop specialist knowledge in trade-service invoicing

* Long-term career opportunities as our group continues to grow



## HOW TO APPLY



Please start your application with:



**Orange invoice – I’m your Invoicer.**



Then provide **five to seven bullet points** explaining your experience with:



* Invoicing or billing

* Processing a high volume of transactions or jobs

* Reviewing labour or timesheets

* Materials, purchase orders or supplier costs

* Australian businesses

* Field-service software, if applicable

* Identifying and resolving invoicing discrepancies



Then complete the following short practical tasks.



APPLICATION TASK PACK



As this role will work heavily within Ascora, we want to see how comfortable you are learning and exploring unfamiliar software.



You do not need previous Ascora experience. In fact, part of this exercise is to assess how you approach learning a new system independently.



TASK 1 – ASCORA PRACTICAL EXERCISE



Visit the Ascora website and register for their free trial.



Spend some time exploring the software and familiarising yourself with the basic workflow.



Then complete the following exercise:



Create a dummy customer.

Please do not use real customer information.

Create a new plumbing service job for that customer.

Add the following charges to the job:

Call-out fee: $90.00 + GST

Labour: 1 hour at $180.00 + GST per hour

Materials: $200.00 + GST

Create an invoice from the job.

Check that the invoice totals are correct.



Your completed invoice should show:



Subtotal excluding GST: $470.00

GST: $47.00

Total including GST: $517.00

WHAT TO SUBMIT



Please provide screenshots showing:



The job you created in Ascora

The labour, call-out and material charges entered

The completed invoice and invoice total



Do not send or
 the invoice. This is only a test job using dummy information.



Then answer these two questions in no more than three sentences each:



1. How easy or difficult did you find Ascora to navigate?



2. If you were unsure how to complete part of the task, what did you do to work it out?



We are not expecting you to already know Ascora.



We are assessing your:



Ability to learn new software independently

Attention to detail

Accuracy when entering job charges

Understanding of GST and invoice totals

Ability to follow written instructions

Initiative when you encounter something you have not done before

TASK 2 – MISSING INFORMATION



You open a completed job in Ascora.



The technician's notes say:



“Repaired leaking pipe. Tested OK.”



The technician has recorded three hours of labour and there is a $280 supplier purchase attached to the job, but the notes do not explain:



Where the leak was located

What caused the leak

What repair was completed

What materials were used



In three to five sentences, explain what you would do before issuing the invoice.



TASK 3 – CUSTOMER-READY INVOICE



A technician records the following job notes:



“Got there tenant showed me toilet running. inlet stuffed changed inlet valve and flexi tested all good cleaned up.”



Rewrite these notes into a short, professional description suitable to appear on a customer invoice.



We are looking for a description that is clear, professional and accurately reflects the technician's notes without adding information that was not provided.



PLEASE ALSO INCLUDE

Your CV in PDF format

Your earliest available start date

Your expected monthly salary in PHP

Details of any invoicing, job-management or field-service software you have previously used

A current internet speed-test result

What "good" looks like in this role – read carefully before applying

-Example 3: You're asked to upload a certificate. Good practice means checking the address and title match the property file, checking the expiry date matches what you're entering into the system, and flagging it immediately if something looks wrong.

If this way of working sounds obvious to you, you're the person we want.

The ideal candidate will have a strong track record in Meta advertising and experience working within the luxury travel, premium hospitality, cruise, tourism, or other high-value markets.  and Instagram) advertising campaigns targeting high-value and luxury travel audiences.

Develop audience strategies focused on North American travellers, particularly those from the US and Canada travelling to Australia.

title: Property Research Analyst / Remote Estimating Assistant
description:
Coastal Holdings Group, Connecticut Shoreline home services



About the role



We run several home services brands on the Connecticut shoreline: gutters, drainage, roofing, tree work, and exterior painting. Before every estimate, the owner needs property research done: assessor records, aerial imagery, elevation and grading data, soil type, flood zone status, permit history, and ownership information. Right now he's pulling this himself in the field, and it's eating time that should go to actual estimates.



You'll build a one page research brief for each property before he arrives. Not raw data, a short summary of the five things he needs to know before walking the site, with sources noted and facts kept separate from inference.



**What you'll do**



- Pull property records: assessor field cards, parcel data, square footage, year built, ownership, permit history

- Pull geospatial data: aerial imagery, elevation/contour data, slope direction, soil classification, flood zone status, wetland or watercourse proximity

- Summarize findings into a short brief: the five most important things to know before the visit, with the source noted for each

- Clearly separate confirmed facts from inference or things that need onsite verification

- Turn around straightforward jobs (gutters) same day, and more complex jobs (drainage, larger projects) within 24 hours



**What we're looking for**



- Comfortable with US property and GIS research, or a fast learner: county assessor sites, Google Earth, NOAA/FEMA flood maps, soil survey tools

- Strong written English, able to summarize clearly and concisely, not just compile a data dump

- Careful and honest about uncertainty. If you don't know, say you don't know. We'd rather have "unconfirmed, verify onsite" than a guess presented as fact

- Comfortable using AI tools to help synthesize research, but able to check and correct AI output rather than pass it through blind

- CAD, GIS, surveying, or civil engineering background is a strong plus, not required

- Available during our business hours (Eastern time), since research needs to be ready before morning appointments



**Hours and pay**



Starting around 20 to 25 hours a week, with room to grow toward full time as the role proves out. Pay based on experience, competitive for the role, paid via Wise.



**To apply**



Tell us a bit about your research experience, any GIS or mapping tools you've used, and what AI tools you use day to day and for what. If it looks like a good fit, next step is a short paid test on a couple of real properties.

title: Senior Funnel Builder
description:
Senior Funnel Builder

Remote | USD $5–$8/hour



We’re looking for a Senior Funnel Builder who thinks beyond the build.



Yes, you should know how to build and maintain high-performing funnels. But more importantly, you should understand why a funnel converts, what makes a product win, and how to turn those insights into new opportunities.



You’ll work closely with our Product Manager and Creative Lead to build, optimize, and continuously improve our funnel portfolio. If you enjoy looking at data, spotting opportunities, testing ideas, and turning one successful concept into several strong variations, we’d love to hear from you.



What You’ll Do



Build, maintain, and optimize funnels using Funnelish.

Conduct regular funnel and quality checks to make sure everything works smoothly.

Review funnels from both a technical and conversion-focused perspective.

Analyze winning products and funnels to understand what is driving their performance.

Create meaningful variations of winning funnels, products, and offers without losing what made the original successful.

Test new angles, offers, hooks, messaging, positioning, and funnel structures.

Write and refine conversion-focused copy, including headlines, hooks, CTAs, offers, upsells, and product messaging.

Use testing and performance insights to continuously improve conversion rates.

Help establish and maintain strong funnel-building and optimization practices across the team.



What We’re Looking For

- 2+ years of experience building and optimizing sales funnels.

- Strong hands-on experience with Funnelish, or the ability to become highly proficient with it quickly.

- Strong conversion-focused copywriting skills.

- A solid understanding of funnel structure, customer journeys, offers, and conversion principles.

- Experience with winner optimization, A/B testing, and developing variations from successful funnels or products.

- The ability to think beyond simply changing colors, layouts, or buttons—you should be able to develop new angles, offers, hooks, and messaging based on what the data is telling you.

- A strong eye for design, usability, and detail.

- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

- Someone who is proactive, reliable, curious, and comfortable working independently.

- CheckoutChamp experience is a plus, but not required.



What Makes You a Great Fit



You don’t just know how to build a funnel, you understand why it converts.

When you see a winning product, you naturally start asking:



Why is this working? What angle is resonating with customers? Which part of the offer is driving the conversion? What other hooks or messages could we test? How can we create new variations without losing what made the original winner successful?



You’re comfortable bringing together technical execution, copywriting, conversion strategy, analysis, and creative testing.



Most importantly, you know how to take one good winner and turn it into multiple opportunities.



How to Apply



When applying, please tell us about your experience with:



1. Funnelish

2. Winner optimization

3. Conversion-focused copywriting

4. Shopify automations

title: Video Editor for a personal brand
description:
Monthly Salary: startin with $800 / month (Potential to grow up between $1000 to $1250 in the following months, depending on the skill level and performance)



We are hiring a Full-Time Video Editor for Hugo de Winter’s personal brand.

Do you have a strong eye for video, understand what makes people stop scrolling, and want to become part of a growing personal branding team?

We are looking for a full-time Video Editor to join our team and work directly on the personal brand of Hugo de 
 give you a bit more context, my name is Stijn and together with my brother Hugo we run a content agency in the Netherlands. Hugo creates content around personal branding, content creation, entrepreneurship, marketing, and building an online presence. And we are looking for someone wo wants to completely take over the edits for Hugo’s socials.



Your job will be to take raw footage and turn it into high-quality, engaging Instagram Reels and YouTube content that people actually want to watch.



We're looking for someone who sees this as an opportunity to become really fucking good at their craft and have fun in the proces.

If this is you, feel free to fill this in: 



Please note: the videos are in Dutch, but we will help with the translations and scripts so that you can work like normal.

We are looking for someone who wants to understand the style, messaging and personality behind the brand and become better at editing with every video. 



Also good to know: I, (Stijn who is writing this) have been an editor for + 10 years, so I will also look with you on how to improve the edits and give you extra tools if needed to improve your craft. So that you can really grow as a person and editor.

Why are we building this team?



We believe that personal brands are becoming one of the most powerful ways to build trust, authority and a business.

But creating great content consistently takes a lot of time.

Our goal is to build a content machine around Hugo where we can consistently produce high-quality content without sacrificing creativity or authenticity.

That's where you come in.



You will become an important part of the creative process and work closely with Hugo, me and the rest of the team. For us, the team culture is very important. We truly care about the people that we work with and we think that having a great connection is the most important thing. With everyone that we work with we always end up becoming friends, so it’s important that we match each others energy and that we can co-create together in a fun environment. 



Job Description

Your core responsibility is to edit mainly short-form, and sometimes long-form content for Hugo's personal brand.

You will receive raw footage from content days, talking-head videos, podcasts, B-roll and other recordings. We will give you the Dutch and English scripts for this so that you know what he says in the reels.

You will turn this footage into content optimized for Instagram, YouTube and other social platforms.



Your main focus will be:

- Editing Instagram Reels

- Editing YouTube videos

- Creating strong hooks and openings

- Improving pacing and retention

- Adding captions and motion graphics

- Selecting the best B-roll

- Finding the strongest moments from long-form footage

- Creating different cuts and iterations of content

- Following Hugo's established editing style

- Continuously improving the style based on what performs well



The goal isn't simply to make videos look good.

The goal is to make people stop scrolling, keep watching and understand the message.



What This Position Entails

- Edit short-form Instagram Reels

- Edit YouTube videos

- Turn long-form footage into multiple short-form pieces

- Create strong first 1–3 seconds

 Add dynamic captions

- Use B-roll, sound effects, zooms and motion graphics where appropriate

- Clean up pacing and remove unnecessary pauses

- Improve storytelling through editing

- Match the existing visual style of the brand

- Study successful content and apply what works

- Create multiple iterations when needed

- Organize project files properly

 Deliver edits on time

- Communicate clearly with the team

- Take feedback and implement it quickly



This is a full-time creative role focused on execution, quality and consistency.

We are looking for someone who is:

- Very good at video editing

- Obsessed with improving their craft

- Has a strong sense of pacing and storytelling

- Understands social media content

- Understands why people keep watching a video

- Has an eye for detail

- Fast without sacrificing quality

- Reliable and consistent

- Comfortable working independently

Proactive rather than waiting for instructions

- Open to feedback and willing to improve

- Able to work with deadlines

- Interested in personal branding, content and entrepreneurship

- Looking for a long-term position, not a short-term freelance gig



You don't need to know everything when you start.

What matters most is that you are hungry to learn, take feedback well and continuously get better.



Editing Software



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects or DaVinci Resolve is preferred.

You should be comfortable working with:

Short-form video

Long-form video

Captions

B-roll

Sound design

Basic motion graphics

Different aspect ratios (9:16, 16:9, etc.)

Experience Criteria

1+ year of video editing experience preferred

Experience editing Instagram Reels / TikToks / YouTube Shorts

Experience with YouTube editing is a plus

Experience working with personal brands or creators is a plus

Understanding of social media content is a plus

Portfolio of previous work is required



We're much more interested in what you can actually create than in your diploma or certificates.



What We Expect From You:

This is a 40-hour-per-week position.

We expect you to treat this as a serious long-term role within our team.



You should have:

- Reliable and fast internet

- A capable computer that can handle video editing

- A quiet and professional working environment

- Good English communication skills

- Availability during agreed working hours

- The ability to meet deadlines consistently

- You will work remotely, but you will be closely connected to the team through daily communication and feedback.



What We Offer:

- Full-time remote position

- Starting pay: $800/month Potential to grow to $1000 / $1250 in the following months, depending on the skill level and  performance)

- Long-term position with room to grow

- Directly working on a growing personal brand

- Clear editing guidelines and SOPs

- Regular feedback and training

- Opportunity to develop your editing skills

- Performance-based raises

- Opportunity to grow into a Senior Video Editor / Creative Lead

- Work from anywhere

- A young, fun, ambitious and creative team

- Growth Opportunity



We are not looking for someone who wants to stay in the exact same position forever.

If you consistently deliver high-quality work, take ownership and show that you can handle more responsibility, there is room to grow.

You could eventually take responsibility for:

- Managing other editors

- Developing our editing systems

- Creating creative concepts

- Analyzing content performance

- Building our content production system

- Becoming a Senior Editor / Creative Lead



Who This Is NOT For

This role is probably not for you if:

- You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every minute

- You don't care about the details

- You regularly miss deadlines

- You aren't comfortable receiving feedback

- You only want to do the bare minimum

- You aren't interested in improving your editing

- You're looking for a temporary side job

- You don't care about social media or content



Please fill in the form above if you feel like your a good fit, we are looking forward to it!

title: Zoning & Site Feasibility Analyst – GIS / Surveying / Land Development
description:
We are a U.S. real estate development company looking for a Land Development Feasibility Analyst to help us identify properties suitable for townhome development.



The main goal of this position is simple:



Analyze a parcel of land and determine approximately how many townhomes we can build on it.



We have a large database of potential development sites. You will work through these properties, research the applicable zoning and development requirements, review the physical characteristics of the land, and estimate the property's potential unit count.



Your analysis will then be used by our team to underwrite the property and determine the appropriate land purchase price.



Responsibilities

Research zoning classifications and permitted residential uses

Determine allowable density and potential townhome unit count

Research setbacks, parking requirements, lot coverage, height limits, minimum lot dimensions, and other development standards

Review GIS maps, parcel maps, assessor information, and public records

Analyze parcel dimensions, shape, road access, easements, and rights-of-way

Identify potential issues involving flood zones, utilities, drainage, topography, or other site constraints

Research city and county zoning ordinances

Evaluate whether a property appears suitable for our townhome development model

Document findings and assumptions clearly

Flag properties that require additional research or professional review

Background We're Looking For



Candidates with backgrounds in any of the following are strongly encouraged to apply:



Geodetic Engineering

Land Surveying

Civil Engineering

GIS / Geospatial Analysis

Zoning

Urban Planning

Land Development

Site Planning



You do not need extensive U.S. real estate experience. We are more interested in finding someone with a strong technical understanding of land who can learn our development process.



Ideal Candidate



You enjoy working with maps, land data, zoning regulations, and technical information.



You are analytical, detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable researching a problem until you find the answer.



Most importantly, you understand that determining development potential requires more than simply looking at acreage. Zoning, density, setbacks, access, easements, parcel configuration, utilities, and other constraints can all affect how many units can actually be built.



This is a long-term opportunity for the right person.



To Apply



Please send a short voice recording introducing yourself and briefly describing your relevant experience.

About the Platform



We have developed a new online professional community and platform for the medical aesthetics industry.

We are now looking for a technically strong and reliable person to take day-to-day ownership of the platform, maintain it and work with us to continue developing it.



The platform has been developed using modern web technologies with significant use of AI-assisted development, including Claude Code. We are therefore particularly interested in developers who are highly comfortable using AI coding tools to develop, troubleshoot and improve an existing application.



The Role



You will become the main technical person responsible for the platform.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Understanding and documenting the existing codebase and architecture

- Managing and maintaining the live application

- Fixing bugs and technical issues

- Developing new features

- Managing the database and backend

- Managing deployments and version control

- Maintaining GitHub repositories

- Monitoring application performance and errors

- Maintaining backups and security

- Managing APIs and third-party integrations

- Working with our existing website, marketing and design teams

- Improving UI/UX where required

- Testing changes before they are released

- Using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or GitHub Copilot to accelerate development

- Advising us when there is a better technical solution rather than simply implementing instructions



We do not expect every line of code to be written manually. We actively encourage intelligent use of AI development tools. However, you must have sufficient development experience to understand, review, test and troubleshoot AI-generated code rather than relying blindly on AI.

- JavaScript / TypeScript

- React and/or Next.js

- Node.js

- PostgreSQL and modern database systems

- Supabase and/or Firebase

- REST APIs and third-party integrations

- Git / GitHub

- Cloud deployment and hosting

- Authentication and user permissions

- Database migrations and backups

- Application security

- Responsive web/mobile development

- Error monitoring and debugging



Experience with community platforms, forums, SaaS products, marketplaces, directories, social networks or membership platforms would be particularly useful.



Experience using Claude Code or similar AI coding agents in real development projects is highly desirable.



The Person We Want



We are looking for somebody who can take ownership rather than waiting for detailed technical instructions.



For example, we may say:



«“We want users to be notified when someone replies to their forum post.”»



We would expect you to understand the requirement, identify the best technical approach, implement it safely, test it and deploy it.



You should be:



- Technically capable

- Resourceful

- Reliable

- Good at problem-solving

- Comfortable working independently

- Able to communicate technical issues in simple English

- Organised and responsive

- Interested in a long-term position



Initial Project



Your first task will be to carry out a technical audit of the existing platform.



This will include reviewing:



- Codebase

- Application architecture

- Database

- Hosting

- Authentication

- APIs

- Security

- Backups

- Deployment process

- GitHub/version control

- Third-party services

- Performance and error monitoring



You will then provide recommendations and help us establish a stable development, staging and production workflow before continuing development.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Your current location in the Philippines.

3. Your availability and preferred working hours.

4. Your expected hourly or monthly salary.

5. Links to 2–3 web applications you have personally worked on.

6. Details of exactly what you were responsible for on those projects.

7. Your experience with React/Next.js and backend/database development.

8. Your experience using Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot or other AI development tools.

9. Your experience taking over and maintaining an existing codebase written by someone else.

10. Your GitHub profile, if available.



Please also answer this question:



You inherit a working web application that has been developed rapidly using Claude Code and several third-party services. Before adding any new features, what are the first five things you would check and why?



Please write your answer yourself rather than using AI to generate a generic response. We are more interested in your actual experience and thought process than a perfect answer.

title: U.S.-Licensed CPA – Full-Service Accounting & Tax Management
description:
## About the Role



I am an international entrepreneur originally from Poland and currently based in Washington State, United States, under F-1 OPT.



I operate three businesses, including LLCs and a sole proprietorship, across software and artificial intelligence, business funding, and surplus funds recovery. My businesses are relatively new, and I want to establish proper accounting and tax processes from the beginning.



In addition to my businesses, I work as an independent contractor through Mercor on AI/ML-related projects.



I have also hired independent contractors from the Philippines through OnlineJobs.ph, with payments made through Wise and other business payment platforms.



I am looking for a U.S.-licensed CPA based in the Philippines to manage my accounting and tax responsibilities on an ongoing, part-time basis.



I am not looking for consultation-only services. I need someone who can take ownership of my accounting and taxes, identify what needs to be done, prepare the necessary documentation, and ensure I meet my obligations without having to figure everything out myself.



As an international entrepreneur managing multiple businesses for the first time, I may not be aware of every accounting or tax requirement that applies to my situation. I would appreciate someone proactive who can identify additional obligations and help me maintain proper financial records as my businesses grow.



## Responsibilities



* Manage bookkeeping and accounting across my businesses.

* Track income, expenses, and legitimate tax write-offs.

* Calculate quarterly estimated taxes.

* Prepare and file personal and applicable business tax returns.

* Manage tax reporting for my LLCs, sole proprietorship, and Mercor income.

* Handle applicable federal and state tax obligations.

* Manage tax documentation for international contractor payments.

* Understand F-1 OPT tax considerations and the accounting implications of E-Verify.

* Monitor tax deadlines and maintain organized financial records.

* Assist with any other accounting, tax, or financial matters I may need help with, including requirements I may not have mentioned because I am not yet aware they apply to my situation.



## Requirements



* Active U.S. CPA license (mandatory).

* Based in the Philippines.

* Experience with U.S. LLCs and sole proprietorships.

* Knowledge of nonresident alien taxation and foreign-owned businesses.

* Experience with U.S. tax preparation, quarterly taxes, and business deductions.

* Familiarity with QuickBooks or similar accounting software.

* Excellent English communication skills.



## How to Apply

2. Your experience with foreign-owned U.S. businesses.

3. Your experience with nonresident alien taxation.

4. Your proposed monthly compensation.

5. Your availability.

Would you be interested in potentially expanding your role to serve external clients, lead accounting operations, or participate in a future accounting business?

title: # STRUCTURAL ENGINEER / BIM & CAD COORDINATION ENGINEER  **Remote Position — Philippines** **U.S.-Based Construction / E
description:
# STRUCTURAL ENGINEER / BIM & CAD COORDINATION ENGINEER



**Remote Position — Philippines**

**U.S.-Based Construction / Engineering Company**



We are seeking a highly capable **Structural Engineer with strong CAD, BIM, and multidisciplinary coordination experience** to join our engineering and construction team remotely from the Philippines.



This is **not a basic drafting position**.



We need someone who understands how a building actually goes together—from foundations and reinforced concrete through structural framing, architectural systems, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, fire protection, penetrations, equipment, and construction sequencing.



The right candidate must be able to review multiple disciplines together, identify conflicts before they reach the field, develop coordinated solutions, and produce accurate professional drawings suitable for U.S. construction projects.



## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



You will assist with the structural engineering, design development, drafting, BIM coordination, and constructability review of residential, commercial, industrial, and specialty construction projects.



Responsibilities include:



* Prepare structural plans, sections, elevations, details, schedules, and construction drawings.

* Develop and modify drawings using **AutoCAD and Revit**.

* Build and maintain coordinated BIM models.

* Review architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, civil, and fire-protection drawings together.

* Perform **clash detection and conflict-control reviews** before drawings reach construction.

* Identify conflicts involving:



  * Structural beams and ductwork

  * Plumbing through beams, slabs, foundations, and grade beams

  * Electrical conduits and structural reinforcement

  * Mechanical equipment and structural framing

  * Roof penetrations

  * Floor penetrations and sleeves

  * Shafts and risers

  * Underground utilities

  * Foundation systems

  * Ceiling-space congestion

  * Equipment clearances

  * Access and maintenance clearances

* Coordinate MEP penetrations through reinforced-concrete walls and slabs.

* Review structural openings before concrete placement.

* Identify conditions that could create field change orders, RFIs, rework, or schedule delays.

* Perform constructability reviews.

* Review drawings for dimensional inconsistencies and missing information.

* Overlay drawings from different disciplines to identify conflicts.

* Maintain clash/conflict logs and track each issue through resolution.

* Prepare RFIs and technical coordination questions when design information is incomplete.

* Incorporate field redlines and as-built conditions into drawings.

* Review shop drawings and submittals for coordination with the design documents.

* Assist with structural calculations and engineering analysis.

* Develop structural details for reinforced concrete, structural steel, masonry, wood framing, foundations, retaining walls, slabs, and related systems.

* Coordinate engineering revisions across all affected sheets rather than making isolated drawing changes.

* Maintain drawing revision control.

* Participate in remote coordination meetings with project management, field personnel, subcontractors, engineers, and other design disciplines.



## STRUCTURAL ENGINEERING KNOWLEDGE



Candidates should have working knowledge of:



* Reinforced concrete

* Cast-in-place concrete

* Slabs-on-grade

* Elevated slabs

* Concrete walls

* Mat/raft foundations

* Spread footings

* Continuous footings

* Grade beams

* Structural columns

* Retaining walls

* Structural steel

* Connections

* Wood framing

* Masonry

* Lateral-force-resisting systems

* Gravity loading

* Wind loading

* Seismic loading

* Load paths

* Structural penetrations

* Construction joints

* Expansion/control joints

* Reinforcement development and lap requirements

* Structural detailing

* Temporary construction conditions and sequencing



Experience with **complex reinforced-concrete structures, below-grade structures, large foundations, retaining systems, or heavily coordinated MEP projects** is strongly preferred.



## MEP COORDINATION KNOWLEDGE



You do not need to be the engineer of record for every MEP discipline, but you **must understand how MEP systems interact with the structure.**



You should be comfortable reviewing:



### Mechanical



* HVAC equipment

* Ductwork

* Mechanical shafts

* Equipment pads

* Roof penetrations

* Required service clearances



### Plumbing



* Sanitary piping

* Domestic water

* Storm drainage

* Floor drains

* Roof drains

* Underground piping

* Sleeves

* Core locations

* Vertical risers

* Equipment connections



### Electrical



* Electrical rooms

* Panels and switchgear

* Conduit routing

* Underground electrical

* Equipment pads

* Sleeves and penetrations

* Clearances

* Major electrical equipment locations



### Fire Protection



* Sprinkler mains

* Branch piping

* Risers

* Penetrations

* Coordination around beams, ducts, ceilings, and other building systems



The objective is simple:



**Find the conflict on the computer—not after concrete has been poured or construction has begun.**



## SOFTWARE REQUIREMENTS



Strong proficiency is expected in:



* **AutoCAD**

* **Autodesk Revit**

* PDF drawing review and markup software such as **Bluebeam Revu**



Experience with the following is highly preferred:



* Autodesk Construction Cloud / BIM 360

* Navisworks Manage

* Revit clash/coordination workflows

* Tekla Structures

* Civil 3D

* ETABS

* SAFE

* SAP2000

* STAAD.Pro

* RISA

* RAM Structural System or similar structural-analysis software

* Microsoft Excel



You do not need to know every program listed, but you must be highly competent with professional CAD/BIM workflows and capable of learning additional software quickly.



## U.S. CODE EXPERIENCE



Because our projects are primarily based in the United States, candidates should have experience with or be capable of working with standards such as:



* International Building Code (IBC)

* ASCE 7

* ACI 318

* AISC 360

* AISC Steel Construction Manual

* TMS masonry requirements where applicable

* NDS wood design requirements where applicable

* Local amendments and project-specific design criteria



Knowledge of U.S. construction-document standards, terminology, dimensions, specifications, and permitting processes is strongly preferred.



## QUALITY CONTROL EXPECTATIONS



We expect extremely high drawing quality.



Before a drawing package is considered complete, you should be checking:



* Dimensions

* Elevations

* Gridlines

* Column locations

* Wall locations

* Beam depths

* Slab thicknesses

* Foundation elevations

* Reinforcement

* Openings

* Sleeves

* Penetrations

* Equipment locations

* MEP routing

* Section references

* Detail references

* Sheet references

* Drawing notes

* Revision consistency

* Constructability

* Conflicts between disciplines



You must be willing to question a drawing when something does not make engineering or construction sense.



We do **not** want someone who simply copies redlines without understanding the purpose of the design.



## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a closely related engineering field.

* Professional experience in structural engineering and/or structural design.

* Strong AutoCAD experience.

* Strong understanding of construction drawings.

* Ability to read architectural, structural, civil, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing plans.

* Strong understanding of reinforced-concrete construction.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Excellent written English communication.

* Ability to communicate technical problems clearly.

* Ability to work independently while following established engineering standards.

* Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote-work environment.

* Ability to manage multiple drawings and revisions without losing document control.



## HIGHLY PREFERRED



Preference will be given to candidates with experience in:



* U.S.-based engineering or construction projects

* Revit structural modeling

* BIM coordination

* Navisworks clash detection

* MEP coordination

* Reinforced-concrete design

* Large or unusual concrete structures

* Underground/below-grade construction

* Construction administration

* Shop-drawing review

* Field coordination

* Design-build construction

* General contractor coordination

* Structural analysis software

* Preparing permit or IFC construction-document packages



Philippine professional engineering credentials are welcomed but are not a substitute for demonstrated technical ability and construction understanding.



## WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are specifically looking for an engineer who thinks beyond their individual drawing.



For example, if you see a plumbing line passing through a structural grade beam, we expect you to identify it.



If an HVAC duct cannot pass beneath a beam while maintaining the required ceiling elevation, identify it.



If a structural column conflicts with an architectural doorway, identify it.



If electrical equipment does not have sufficient working clearance, identify it.



If a penetration is shown through a heavily reinforced concrete wall but no structural opening has been coordinated, identify it **before construction**.



We want someone who thinks:



**“How will they actually build this?”**



—not simply:



**“Does my drawing look correct?”**



## WORKING RELATIONSHIP



This is a remote Philippines-based position supporting a U.S. construction and engineering organization.



The engineer will work directly with company leadership, project managers, construction personnel, subcontractors, and other engineering disciplines.



Some schedule overlap with **U.S. Central Time** will be required for coordination meetings and project communication.



Depending on experience and performance, this position can develop into a long-term engineering leadership role with responsibility for multidisciplinary coordination, BIM standards, drawing quality control, and engineering production.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



1. Resume/CV.

2. Years of structural engineering experience.

3. Years of AutoCAD experience.

4. Years of Revit/BIM experience.

5. List of structural-analysis programs you use.

6. Description of your experience coordinating structural drawings with MEP systems.

7. Examples of structural drawings or BIM models you personally produced, with confidential project information removed.

8. Examples of concrete, foundation, steel, or other structural projects you have completed.

9. Description of your experience working on U.S. projects, if applicable.

10. Your current work availability.

11. Your expected monthly compensation in PHP.

12. Computer specifications and internet connection information.



### IMPORTANT APPLICATION QUESTION



Include a short response explaining how you would handle this situation:



**A 600 mm deep reinforced-concrete beam crosses the planned route of a major HVAC duct, while a plumbing line and electrical cable tray are also competing for the same ceiling space. Construction has not started. Explain how you would identify, document, coordinate, and resolve the conflict before issuing the drawings for construction.**



Applications that do not answer this technical question may not be considered.



**Position:** Structural Engineer / BIM & CAD Coordination Engineer

**Location:** Philippines — Remote

**Industry:** Structural Engineering / Construction / Design-Build

**Employment:** Long-term opportunity
