Right now our concepts are outpacing our hands. Our creative strategist builds the scripts, hooks and angles off real performance data, and our creators shoot the content. What we need is someone who can take those briefings and that footage and turn them into scroll-stopping, converting video ads.



It's for someone who owns the craft of editing and gets sharper every single week.

- Turn briefings from our creative strategist and raw creator footage into finished direct-response video ads for Meta

- Edit high-converting UGC and short-form ads: hooks, pacing, captions and sound design

- Match every cut to the exact line it sits under. Most editors grab b-roll that's vaguely on-topic and the ad dies. You won't.

- Spot what's working and scale it. When a concept wins, we make more of it.



Why this seat is different

- You see the data. You get access to all our performance numbers, so you always know what's working and why.

- Weekly call with your lead. We go through your ads together, you get direct feedback, and you level up off it. No guessing.

- We pay for your tools. Every tool and subscription you need is on us. Find a new one that makes you faster or better? Tell us and we'll get it.



Full-time, long-term. We want someone in the business with us.



Where this can lead

Editor → Editor Lead → (if it's really in you) Creative Strategist.



Every step is a pay rise, based on performance. If you start thinking about why an ad works, not just how to cut it, you'll move fast.



You'll thrive here if

- You edit high-converting UGC and short-form video ads

None of those people last here.

title: Senior Hospitality Bookkeeper (Xero Australian Accounting)
description:
We are Roger Financial, a specialist hospitality accounting firm working with Australian restaurants, cafes, bars and hospitality groups.



We handle bookkeeping, payroll, supplier administration, accounts payable, reconciliations and reporting, and we give our clients weekly P&L dashboards, budget vs actual reporting, expense breakdowns, KPI trends and GST visibility.



Our goal is to provide value to our clients in 3 ways:

1) We save them time

2) We keep them compliant with the ATO

3) We provide them with real insight into the performance of their business every week.



We are growing fast. Three months ago we had two clients. Today we have fourteen. This is a real chance to grow with us and step into a leadership role as we scale.



We just had our part-time bookkeeper leave us as they found our growth too overwhelming. We want someone who wants to stay with us for years & end up leading a team of bookkeepers inside 12 months.



HOW ARE WE GROWING SO FAST?



Here is what makes us different. We are half the cost of regular bookkeeping firms because AI is embedded in our business. We use Claude Code & Lovable heavily, with our bookkeepers expected to integrate this within their practice. You must be tech-savvy, AI friendly & serious about being on the forefront of bookkeeping.



While many firms have a 1:5 bookkeeper to client ratio, we aim for 1:15. We pay well, and are really lovely, BUT you must be efficient & on the ball.



This is a full-time and exclusive position. You work for Roger Financial only. Please do not try to juggle this job with another, it will be very obvious & it'll be a waste of both of our time.

We are looking for someone who wants this to be their career and takes it seriously.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



3 things that matter most to us are simple.



1) You must be an excellent bookkeeper, fast & familiar with Australian bookkeeping & Xero (!!).

You must know how to do double entry bookkeeping, reconcile sales invoices against bank transactions in clearing accounts etc. Please do not apply unless you have at least 5 years experience (unless you absolutely tick other boxes). You also need to be tech and AI enabled. You want to use AI in your work, you are excited by it rather than threatened by it, and you are always looking for a faster and cleaner way to do things.



2) You must have real Australian hospitality bookkeeping experience. You must know how to reconcile sales & Lightspeed invoices against bank transactions in clearing accounts (!!)

If you have not done hospitality books for Australian businesses, this is not the right role for you. Our clients love us because we don't just "do their books". We actually act as a partner for them, they trust us to tell them how they're going, is their COGS ratio too high, is their revenue supporting a healthy rent ratio etc. You need to understand hospitality bookkeeping. You must know how to reconcile sales & Lightspeed invoices against bank transactions in clearing accounts (!!)



3) We need a genuinely strong communicator who wants to be a leader of a team (!!).

You are confident, you have personality, you are not shy, and you are comfortable talking directly to clients and one day leading a team. As we grow, this role will turn into a Bookkeeping Team Leader position managing other bookkeepers, so we want someone who thinks about how to make the whole team better, not just their own desk.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Review and approve AI-categorised bills and invoices in Xero. The AI does the first draft, you check it, correct it and make it better.

- Reconcile bank feeds, credit cards, merchant facilities and payment platforms in Xero.

- Reconcile Square and Lightspeed sales back to bank settlements, netting off fees and clearing accounts correctly. This is a big part of hospitality work and needs to be second nature.

- Reconcile delivery platforms like Uber Eats and DoorDash to Xero.

- Process supplier invoices through Hubdoc and Dext where needed.

- Complete weekly supplier statement reconciliations and manage accounts payable, including preparing weekly ABA batch files.

- Process payroll in Xero, including payslips, STP, super and PAYG.

- Keep clean, BAS-ready books that are fully reconciled ahead of each quarter.

- Prepare weekly P&L and reporting, and communicate it directly to your clients with useful commentary.

- Own your client relationships. Own the work. You will have to chase suppliers constantly etc when onboarding clients.

- Record your processes in Loom and build workflows the rest of the team will follow. If you do something more than once, we want it documented.



MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS



- Australian Hospitality bookkeeping experience. This is non-negotiable.

- At least 5 years of Australian bookkeeping or accounting experience, working with Australian companies.

- Strong Xero. You need to be genuinely expert here, not just familiar.

- Confident with the Australian hospitality software stack: Square, Lightspeed, Lightyear, Deputy, Tanda, Hubdoc and Dext.

- Square and Lightspeed reconciliation especially.

- BAS-ready bookkeeping with correct GST coding.

- A strong communicator with real personality. Confident on client calls and emails, not shy, and ready to lead a team.

- Tech and AI enabled. You want AI to be part of how you work.

- Full-time and exclusive. You are not working another job or running side clients. You are all in on this one.

- Degree in accounting or a related field.



HOSPITALITY KNOWLEDGE



You should understand, or be very keen to learn fast:

Cost of goods and what healthy food and beverage cost percentages look like (target 28 to 32%).

Labour cost percentage and what is acceptable (target 28 to 32%).

Prime cost, which is COGS plus labour, and why 60% is the line that matters.

Rent percentage benchmarks.

Square and Lightspeed POS reconciliation, matching sales reports to bank settlements and platform fees.

Clearing account reconciliation and how sales, fees and settlements net to zero.

Delivery platform reconciliation for Uber Eats, DoorDash and similar.



ROLE DETAILS



Full-time, 40 hours per week.

Working hours align with Australian business hours. 8am - 4pm PHT (10am - 6pm AEST). Do NOT work multiple jobs.

Fast-growing firm with real room to grow. This role is intended to become a Bookkeeping Team Leader position managing junior bookkeepers as we scale.



TO APPLY, PLEASE ANSWER THE FOLLOWING.



Tell us why you match the 3 things that matter most to us. And why this job ad speaks to you. No generic, ChatGPT answers please. Also ensure you include your resume, Gmail & at least 2 contactable references.



SKILL REQUIREMENT

Accounts Reconciliations, Xero, Bookkeeping

title: Point of View (POV) driving video
description:
I am looking for a high-quality, Point of View (POV) driving video. The final product must feel completely immersive, as if the viewer is actually sitting in the driver's seat.

Reference Style: Please review the YouTube channel SEAN McLaren P for the exact pacing, camera angle, and audio focus I need.

1. Camera & Audio Setup

 Camera Mount: You must use a head mount or a helmet chin mount. Chest mounts sit too low and cut off the windshield, ruining the true driver's perspective.

 Camera Settings: Record in 1080p or higher resolution at 60fps. Use an Ultra-Wide or SuperView lens setting so the steering wheel, dashboard, and the road are all visible at once. In-camera stabilization (like HyperSmooth) must be turned on.

 Audio (Crucial): Audio makes or breaks a POV video. Please use a binaural microphone setup (in-ear mics) or a high-quality external stereo mic inside the cabin. Keep the windows rolled up for the majority of the drive to avoid wind distortion.

2. Video Structure (Shot List)

Please film the video in one continuous take or clear sequential clips following this structure:

 Exterior Walkaround (2-3 mins): Start outside. Walk around the entire car smoothly. Open the trunk, show the rear seats, and finally get into the driver's seat.

 Start-Up & Interior (2 mins): Once seated, look at the dashboard and start the engine. Let the exhaust sound play out. Slowly glance at the infotainment screen, center console, and test a few tactile buttons (indicators, windows, climate controls).

 The Drive (10-15 mins):

 Casual Drive: Drive smoothly in normal traffic.

 Acceleration: Find a safe, open stretch of road or a tunnel to accelerate (in Sport Mode if applicable) so the engine tone is clearly audible.

 Night Drive (Bonus): If the car features strong interior ambient lighting, recording at night is highly preferred.

3. Driving & Recording Rules

 Total Silence: There should be absolutely no talking and no radio/music. Let the car's mechanics do the talking—whether you're recording a modern VW Golf 7 or a classic like a Mercedes 190E, viewers are there to hear the engine and interior clicks.

 Smooth Head Movements: Move your head slowly and deliberately. When looking at the mirrors or center console, pause for a full second before looking back at the road. Rapid head movements will ruin the footage.

 Hand Position: Keep both hands visible on the steering wheel in a professional position whenever you aren't shifting gears or operating the screen.

4. Deliverables

 Deliver the raw, unedited 4K video files (or lightly color-graded if we agreed upon a specific LUT).

 Thumbnail Assets: Before or after the drive, please take a few crisp, eye-level photos of the car's exterior front angle and the interior dashboard. These are necessary to build bold, split-screen thumbnails.

We need a dependable Remote HVAC Service Coordinator / Dispatcher to own service requests from the first customer call through technician dispatch, follow-up, and completed work order. This is a live phone and dispatch position—not general data entry.



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Answer customer calls and
s professionally.

• Collect complete service information: contact, location, equipment, symptoms, access instructions, urgency, and billing or PO requirements.

• Create clear, accurate work orders.

• Use Google Workspace, Dropbox, and our work-order/dispatch software.



You are not expected to diagnose HVAC equipment. You must ask the right questions, document accurately, avoid unauthorized promises, and escalate issues properly.



REQUIREMENTS

• Proven field-service dispatch, service coordination, or similar phone-based experience.

• Excellent spoken and written English.

• Confident handling urgent and upset customers.

• Strong scheduling judgment, attention to detail, and follow-through.

HVAC, refrigeration, plumbing, electrical, or other field-service experience is strongly preferred. Experience with field-service software, QuickBooks, Google Workspace, or Dropbox is helpful.



SCHEDULE AND PAY

• Philippines-based remote position.

• Full-time, Monday through Friday.

• 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, including a one-hour unpaid break.

• This is normally 8:00 PM–5:00 AM or 9:00 PM–6:00 AM in the Philippines, depending on U.S. daylight-saving time.

title: Paid: 2D artist wanted for a cozy indie mining game (Ores & Odds)
description:
2D Character Artist — Painted Style — Indie Unity Game

ABOUT THE PROJECT

Ores & Odds is a mining-and-gambling game built in Unity by a solo developer

(DigiKerr). You break ore, press your luck, and try to win back a mine from the

man who took it. The game is playable start to finish, has a demo and an active

playtest group, and is heading to Kickstarter and Steam Early Access.

THE WORK

I'm hiring an artist to create the game's final 2D character art. The art

currently in the build is placeholder work made to prototype the game, and it's

being replaced with human-drawn art. You'd work from that placeholder art plus

written design notes as reference and produce the real thing.

The cast: Wick (an old miner who lost his mine), Jesper Crooke (the charming and

dangerous man who owns it now), a merchant, a set of collectible "Folk"

characters, and background miners. A style reference is attached — this is the

look the whole cast needs to match.

REQUIRED SKILLS

1. Stylized 2D character illustration, with demonstrated ability to match a

   provided style reference rather than work in your own style. Please link

   examples where you drew to someone else's style guide or existing property.

2. Game-ready delivery in layered, separable parts. The characters are cut-out

   puppets — head, torso and arms animate separately — so I need layered source

   files with elements on their own layers, not flattened images.

3. Consistency across a cast and across states: the same character recognizable

   across multiple poses, expressions and props. Expression sheets or sprite

   sheets in your portfolio are ideal.

DELIVERABLES

- Layered source files (PSD or equivalent), elements on separate layers

- Transparent PNG exports at agreed resolution

- Consistent sizing and pivot alignment across the cast

TO APPLY

- Link a portfolio including at least one example of style-matched work

- Confirm you can deliver layered files with separable parts

- Tell me in one or two sentences how you'd approach the attached reference

- Begin your reply with the word PICKAXE so I know you read this post

title: Estimator / Engineer with Onsite Experience
description:
Company Overview

We’re a small group of big thinkers working together like a well-oiled machine.

We much rather work with a few exceptional individuals than a lot of average people.

A little bit our company,

We’re based in Sydney NSW

We started in 2022

We specialise in Remedial Construction which is fixing and improving existing buildings that have problems or need updates.

It includes a wide range of activities to keep buildings safe, strong, and looking good.

1. Waterproofing

2. Concrete repairs

3. Masonry repairs

4. Facade restoration

Job Summary

The Estimating Virtual Assistant plays a crucial support role within our pre-construction team, ensuring efficient and organized estimation processes.

This position is instrumental in managing administrative tasks, organizing project documentation, and supporting the Estimator and Pre-Construction Manager with detailed preparation for upcoming projects.

The role demands a high level of organization, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Meeting Coordination: Schedule and coordinate virtual meetings, including pre-construction meetings, bid discussions, and project debriefs, ensuring all necessary participants are informed and prepared.

• Deadline Management: Monitor and record project deadlines, providing timely reminders to the team to ensure that submissions and responses are prepared well in advance.

• Job Folder Organization: Set up and maintain digital job folders, ensuring that all project-related documents are accurately filed and easily accessible.

• Document Preparation and Control: Assist in compiling construction markups and preparing bills of quantities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with project requirements.

• Contractor Procurement and Management: Source new contractors, evaluate their qualifications, and maintain an up-to-date contractor list, facilitating effective bid processes and project execution.

• Administrative Support: Provide comprehensive administrative support to the estimating team, including, drafting correspondence, and any other tasks that contribute to the efficiency of the estimating process.

• Follow-Up and Feedback: Organize and manage the collection of feedback from clients and internal tea
mbers post-project completion to identify areas for improvement and celebrate successes.

• Communication: Act as a point of contact for internal and external queries related to estimation projects, ensuring clear and prompt communication.

• Data Management and Analysis: Organize and manage project data, including historical cost data, for easy access and analysis. This can help in making more accurate future estimates.

• Market Research: Conduct online research to stay updated on market trends, material costs, and the availability of subcontractors, which can influence project estimates and bids.

• Monthly Tender Reporting: Support the creation of tender reports related to projects, such as status, total amount of projects tendered, dollar value etc.



Skills and Qualifications

• Skills

o Technical Proficiency: Strong computer skills and proficiency in Plan Swift, MS Office, especially Excel, and familiarity with construction management software.

o Organizational Skills: Exceptional organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.

o Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in all aspects of work.

o Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

o Proactivity and Initiative: Ability to work independently, take initiative, and proactively address potential issues before they arise.

• Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Architecture, or Quantity Surveying

• Experience:

o Experience has a quantity surveyor is preferred.

o Experience in reading and understanding drawings and technical specifications.

Work Environment

• The Estimating Virtual Assistant will operate in a dynamic, fast-paced office setting within our pre-construction department.

• Collaboration with the Estimator and Pre-Construction Manager are key components of the role.

• The position may require occasional site visits and participation in project meetings.

• This position is fully remote, providing the flexibility to work from home.

• The Estimating Virtual Assistant will be part of a supportive virtual team, with regular online meetings and communication channels to stay connected and aligned with the team's goals and projects.

Employment Type, Compensation, and Benefits

• Compensation: TBC on Candidate

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor Needed for YouTube Channel, 10 to 15 Minute Videos**



Hey there! I'm starting a brand new YouTube channel and looking for a video editor to join me on this journey. I've run channels before and worked with a lot of different editors over the years, and now I'm ready to build a real team again, starting with the right editor, then growing from there as things take off.



Videos are typically 10 to 15 minutes long, and I care deeply about the audio experience. Sound design and music are just as important to me as the visuals. I'm really interested in the audio side of editing specifically. The sound effects, the pacing, and that human emotional connection are absolutely key for this niche.



**IMPORTANT: NO AI GENERATED CONTENT. NO AI IMAGES. NO AI VIDEO. NO AI, PERIOD.** This channel is built on genuine, hands on, human editing only. I want it to feel personal and real, and that human touch matters more to me than anything else.



What you'll be doing:



Edit videos using a human voiceover that I'll provide. Source and gather your own supplemental clips and footage, in addition to clips I send you. Clean, polished editing with smooth pacing, no rough cuts or jarring transitions. Add on screen text where it helps, for emphasis or key points, used strategically, not overdone. Select and mix background music and sound effects that are free to use on YouTube with no copyright strikes. Create a personal, intimate feeling in the audio. This is a top priority for me. Match the tone and quality bar of these channels, which I'll share as reference: Beyond the Blue, Octo Lab, Beyond the Green, Fossil Videos, Mister Science, and Primordia Origins.



What I'm looking for in you:



A strong portfolio of similar long form YouTube edits. An excellent ear for music and sound design and pacing. Comfort sourcing b-roll and stock clips independently. Reliable communication, and openness to feedback and revisions. Ambition and a willingness to put in the work. I know editing takes real time and effort, but I promise it's genuinely fun once we find our rhythm together.



Before we move forward, I'd love to see a short sample of your work in this style. I can send you a Google Drive with the footage and voiceover, and you can put together a two minute sample so I can get a feel for your skills in this niche.



I really appreciate all the editors out there and everything you do. I can't wait to hopefully find the right fit and start building something great together.

title: Accounting Manager (Remote — Philippines)
description:
Accounting Manager (Remote — Philippines)



We are a Canadian CPA firm providing fractional CFO and financial reporting services, primarily to publicly traded junior mining and exploration companies. We are a lean, high-standard team: four staff accountants take files from bookkeeping through draft financial statements, and our Principal (a CPA) performs final review before anything reaches auditors or regulators.



We are hiring a CPA manager to be the technical reviewer and day-to-day leader of our accounting team.



What you will own

- Technical review of staff work: lead sheets, working papers, reconciliations, and draft financial statements — footing, cross-casting, tie-outs, disclosure

- Manage, coach, and develop our 4 staff accountants; run the review process so files reach final review clean

- Own month-end close checklists and working-paper standards across the team

- IFRS financial reporting for junior mining/exploration clients (exploration expenditures, flow-through financings, share capital transactions, warrants, stock options, related-party transactions)

- Act as audit liaison: prepare files and support external auditors at year-end

- Flag technical issues and risks to the Principal before final review



What this role is not

Billing, collections, and all client / CEO / board relationships stay with the Principal. This is a technical-review and team-leadership role — not a business-development or client-facing one.



Requirements

- Licensed CPA (Philippines); Big 4 experience strongly preferred (SGV & Co., Isla Lipana & Co., R.G. Manabat & Co., Navarro Amper & Co.)

- 4+ years of progressive accounting experience, including review or supervisory experience

- Strong IFRS knowledge; experience with mining/extractive clients a major plus

- Hands-on with QuickBooks Online and/or Xero; Caseware an asset

- Excellent written and spoken English; able to give clear, direct feedback

- Reliable home-office setup; comfortable with overlapping Vancouver afternoons (approx. 4:00–9:00 AM Manila time)



Compensation

- ₱110,000–150,000 per month, plus an annual 13th-month bonus

- Paid in PHP via Wise

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE

PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT

OR A SALE.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



If you have never worked a graveyard shift before, think carefully before applying. We will ask you specifically how you plan to structure your sleep, and how you'll make the schedule work alongside your family or partner. "I'll figure it out" is not an answer that gets you hired. This shift is sustainable for people who plan for it and difficult for people who don't.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 15-minute pre-screen async interview

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



A NOTE ON TIMING



We hire for this role on a rolling basis and are always reviewing applications, so the timeline varies. Sometimes we're interviewing within a week of your application. Sometimes a seat opens a month or two later. If you're a strong fit, we'll keep you in our pipeline and reach out when there's an opening.



---



HOW TO APPLY

Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.

title: SENIOR ARCHITECTURAL DESIGNER
description:
# SENIOR ARCHITECTURAL DESIGNER – LUXURY RESIDENTIAL & BIM COORDINATION



**Remote Position — Philippines**

**U.S.-Based Development / Construction / Engineering Company**



We are seeking an exceptional **Senior Architectural Designer** with strong experience in **high-end residential architecture, custom homes, luxury interiors, architectural detailing, Revit/BIM, AutoCAD, and multidisciplinary construction coordination**.



This is **not a basic drafting position**.



We are looking for someone who can take an architectural concept and develop it into a sophisticated, buildable, coordinated design.



The ideal candidate understands both sides of architecture:



**Design excellence + construction reality.**



You should be able to create beautiful spaces while simultaneously considering structural systems, mechanical equipment, plumbing, electrical, lighting, ceiling conditions, cabinetry, waterproofing, drainage, accessibility, constructability, and actual field installation.



## WHAT YOU WILL DESIGN



Projects may include:



* Luxury custom residences

* High-end renovations

* Estate homes

* Modern residential architecture

* Commercial spaces

* Offices

* Specialty structures

* Outdoor living areas

* Pools and spas

* High-end kitchens

* Primary suites

* Custom bathrooms

* Theaters

* Entertainment spaces

* Specialty rooms

* Architectural staircases

* Double-height spaces

* Custom millwork

* Exterior architectural features

* Landscape-integrated architecture

* Complex below-grade and concrete structures



We want someone capable of designing architecture that feels **intentional, premium, timeless, technically sophisticated, and fully coordinated.**



---



# PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



You will assist with architecture from early concept development through detailed construction documents.



Responsibilities include:



* Develop architectural concepts from owner/project requirements.

* Produce floor plans, reflected ceiling plans, elevations, sections, wall sections, and architectural details.

* Prepare complete architectural construction-document packages.

* Develop designs using **Revit and AutoCAD**.

* Create and maintain coordinated BIM models.

* Develop sophisticated space-planning solutions.

* Design architectural circulation and room relationships.

* Develop building massing and exterior elevations.

* Design custom architectural features.

* Coordinate finish materials and transitions.

* Develop ceiling designs and lighting integration.

* Coordinate architectural elements with structural and MEP systems.

* Coordinate doors, windows, openings, stairs, millwork, cabinetry, equipment, and fixtures.

* Develop enlarged plans for kitchens, bathrooms, specialty rooms, and complex architectural areas.

* Develop architectural details that can actually be constructed.

* Produce presentation drawings and design-development packages.

* Create or coordinate high-quality architectural renderings.

* Review plans for constructability.

* Review contractor and consultant drawings for conflicts.

* Develop RFIs and coordination questions when required.

* Incorporate field conditions and design revisions into drawings.

* Maintain proper drawing revision control.



---



# HIGH-END DESIGN EXPECTATIONS



We are specifically looking for someone with strong architectural judgment.



You should understand:



* Scale

* Proportion

* Symmetry

* Asymmetrical balance

* Visual hierarchy

* Sight lines

* Spatial sequencing

* Natural light

* Artificial lighting

* Ceiling heights

* Material transitions

* Architectural rhythm

* Exterior massing

* Façade composition

* Indoor/outdoor relationships

* Furniture planning

* Circulation

* Privacy

* Acoustics

* Human experience within a space



You should be capable of designing a room beyond simply placing four walls around it.



For example, when designing a luxury great room, you should be thinking about:



* Entry sight line

* Window placement

* Ceiling architecture

* Structural column locations

* Furniture arrangement

* Fireplace proportions

* Lighting

* HVAC diffusers

* Speaker placement

* Electrical outlets

* AV systems

* Artwork locations

* Chandelier position

* Exterior views

* Door relationships

* Material transitions



Everything should feel coordinated.



---



# BIM / CAD REQUIREMENTS



Strong proficiency is expected in:



* **Autodesk Revit**

* **AutoCAD**

* PDF review and markup software such as Bluebeam Revu



Experience with the following is highly preferred:



* Autodesk Construction Cloud / BIM 360

* Navisworks

* SketchUp

* Enscape

* Lumion

* Twinmotion

* V-Ray

* 3ds Max

* Rhino

* Photoshop

* Illustrator

* InDesign



You do not need to know every program listed.



However, you must be highly capable with professional architectural drafting and BIM workflows.



---



# ARCHITECTURAL VISUALIZATION



Strong visualization skills are highly valued.



Candidates with experience producing:



* Photorealistic architectural renderings

* Exterior renderings

* Interior renderings

* Material studies

* Lighting studies

* Walkthroughs

* Architectural animations

* Concept presentations



will receive strong consideration.



Rendering quality should support **high-end architectural presentation**, not basic conceptual modeling.



---



# STRUCTURAL COORDINATION



You must understand enough structural design to recognize when architecture conflicts with the structure.



You should be able to coordinate architectural plans with:



* Structural columns

* Concrete walls

* Structural beams

* Steel framing

* Load-bearing walls

* Foundation systems

* Grade beams

* Elevated slabs

* Roof framing

* Shear walls

* Large openings

* Stair openings

* Double-height spaces



You are not expected to replace the structural engineer.



You **are expected to recognize conflicts**.



For example:



If a structural column lands directly in the middle of an important architectural sight line, you should identify the issue during design coordination—not after construction begins.



---



# MEP COORDINATION



You must understand how architecture interacts with:



### HVAC



* Supply diffusers

* Return-air locations

* Duct routing

* Mechanical equipment

* Thermostat locations

* Linear diffusers

* Ceiling coordination



### Plumbing



* Fixture locations

* Drain locations

* Wet-wall alignment

* Plumbing chases

* Vent stacks

* Floor drains

* Roof drains

* Equipment requirements



### Electrical



* Lighting

* Receptacles

* Switch locations

* Electrical panels

* AV equipment

* Lighting controls

* Specialty power requirements



### Low Voltage / Technology



* Speakers

* Cameras

* Data

* Wi-Fi access points

* TVs

* Control panels

* Automation systems



The architectural drawings should not be developed in isolation.



---



# CLASH DETECTION & DESIGN COORDINATION



You should continuously review drawings for conflicts between:



**Architecture + Structure + Mechanical + Electrical + Plumbing + Civil + Interior Design + Landscape**



Examples include:



* Ductwork crossing structural beams

* Plumbing risers conflicting with architectural openings

* Columns interfering with doors

* Ceiling designs conflicting with HVAC equipment

* Light fixtures conflicting with diffusers

* Cabinetry interfering with electrical devices

* Plumbing fixtures lacking adequate wall cavities

* Roof drains interfering with structural framing

* Stair geometry conflicting with required headroom

* Windows conflicting with structural elements

* Mechanical equipment visible from important architectural areas



The goal is to solve these issues **before construction**.



---



# CONSTRUCTION DOCUMENT QUALITY



We expect exceptionally clean architectural drawings.



Before a drawing package is released, you should verify:



* Dimensions

* Room sizes

* Wall locations

* Door locations

* Window locations

* Ceiling heights

* Floor elevations

* Stair geometry

* Section references

* Detail references

* Material transitions

* Structural coordination

* MEP coordination

* Accessibility requirements

* Fixture clearances

* Cabinetry dimensions

* Equipment clearances

* Exterior elevations

* Roof relationships

* Waterproofing conditions

* Drainage conditions

* Constructability



Changes must be coordinated throughout the entire drawing package.



Changing something on one floor plan without updating the affected elevations, sections, structural interfaces, reflected ceiling plans, or details is unacceptable.



---



# U.S. CONSTRUCTION KNOWLEDGE



Experience working on U.S. projects is strongly preferred.



Candidates should have experience with or be capable of learning and applying relevant requirements including:



* International Residential Code

* International Building Code

* Energy-code requirements

* ADA requirements where applicable

* Life-safety requirements

* Means of egress

* Stair requirements

* Guard and handrail requirements

* Minimum room and clearance requirements

* Fire separation requirements

* U.S. construction-document conventions



Local jurisdiction requirements will vary by project.



---



# REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Bachelor's degree in Architecture or a closely related field.

* Strong architectural-design portfolio.

* Strong Revit experience.

* Strong AutoCAD experience.

* Strong understanding of architectural construction drawings.

* Experience developing construction-document packages.

* Ability to read structural and MEP drawings.

* Strong understanding of architectural detailing.

* Strong spatial-design ability.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Excellent written English communication.

* Ability to receive design direction and intelligently develop it.

* Ability to work independently.

* Ability to manage multiple revisions without losing drawing coordination.

* Reliable workstation and high-speed internet connection.



---



# HIGHLY PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Preference will be given to candidates with experience in:



* Luxury residential architecture

* Custom homes

* Estate homes

* High-end interiors

* Modern architecture

* Revit BIM modeling

* U.S. construction projects

* Design-build construction

* Construction administration

* Structural coordination

* MEP coordination

* Custom millwork

* Detailed kitchen and bathroom design

* Architectural lighting coordination

* Complex reinforced-concrete projects

* Pools and spas

* Outdoor living environments

* Specialty architectural spaces

* High-end architectural visualization



---



# WHO WE DO NOT WANT



We are not looking for someone whose primary skill is simply tracing drawings or following redlines.



We do not want:



* A basic CAD operator

* Someone who only creates conceptual renderings

* Someone who designs without understanding construction

* Someone who ignores structural or MEP conflicts

* Someone who requires every architectural decision to be explained step-by-step

* Someone who changes one drawing without coordinating the rest of the project



We need someone who can **think architecturally and technically.**



---



# WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



When you review a design, your thought process should include questions such as:



**Does this look exceptional?**



**Does the space feel properly proportioned?**



**How will this actually be constructed?**



**Where is the structure?**



**Where are the ducts?**



**Where does the plumbing run?**



**Where are the electrical panels and controls?**



**Will the lighting layout remain architecturally clean?**



**Are the ceiling conditions coordinated?**



**Can the contractor build what is shown?**



**Are there conflicts that nobody else has identified yet?**



That level of thinking is what we expect.



---



# REMOTE WORKING RELATIONSHIP



This is a remote Philippines-based position supporting a U.S. development, engineering, and construction organization.



You may work directly with:



* Ownership

* Project management

* Structural engineering

* MEP engineering

* Construction superintendents

* Subcontractors

* Vendors

* Interior designers

* Consultants



Some working-hour overlap with **U.S. Central Time** will be required for project coordination.



For the right candidate, this can become a long-term position with increasing responsibility for architectural design, BIM standards, quality control, and design leadership.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



1. Resume/CV.

2. Architectural portfolio.

3. Examples of complete construction drawings you personally developed.

4. Examples of Revit models.

5. Examples of luxury residential or high-end architectural projects.

6. Examples of interior architectural work.

7. Examples of exterior/elevation design.

8. Examples of renderings, if applicable.

9. Years of Revit experience.

10. Years of AutoCAD experience.

11. Description of your experience working with U.S. construction projects.

12. Description of your structural and MEP coordination experience.

13. Software you are proficient in.

14. Current availability.

15. Expected monthly compensation in PHP.

16. Computer/workstation specifications.

17. Internet connection information.



## REQUIRED TECHNICAL DESIGN QUESTION



Include a response to the following scenario:



**You are designing a high-end two-story great room with a large chandelier, full-height windows, architectural ceiling features, concealed HVAC, integrated speakers, and large structural beams. During coordination, you discover that the original HVAC duct route crosses a structural beam and the proposed chandelier location conflicts with structural framing. Explain how you would coordinate the architecture, structure, lighting, mechanical systems, and ceiling design to resolve the conflicts without degrading the architectural intent.**



We want to understand **how you think**, not just what software you know.



---



**Position:** Senior Architectural Designer – Luxury Residential & BIM Coordination

**Location:** Philippines — Remote

**Industry:** Architecture / Development / Engineering / Construction

**Project Focus:** Luxury Residential, Custom Construction & Specialty Projects

**Employment:** Long-term opportunity

About the Role

We are a premium comfort footwear brand built for how people actually live — designing from the inside out with fit, feel, and function first. We sell direct to consumers and through wholesale partners across Europe and the USA. The product is in the market, the demand is real, and our international footprint is expanding. We are now building the operating discipline that helps a small team serve customers reliably without becoming slow or corporate.

This is an execution role for someone who is precise, fast to learn, and uncomfortable leaving loose ends. You will keep daily operations moving: orders, data, documents, 3PL follow-up, customer exceptions, and task closure. You are joining as our first dedicated remote back-office operations coordinator — the starting scope is deliberately focused and part-time, with real opportunity to grow as the business scales.



Your First 90 Days

Run assigned order and exception queues without missed follow-ups

Maintain accurate customer, order, shipment, and inventory data

Document the recurring workflows you operate

Reduce founder and Head of Operations involvement in routine status chasing

Work Structure & Requirements

Location: Remote / Virtual 

Schedule: Part-time, 20–30 hours per week to start; expands only when the queue proves the need

Time Zone: HKT — reliable coverage of an agreed European shift is required

Compensation: $10 USD per hour + up to 5% quarterly performance bonus



Key Responsibilities

1. Order & Data Management

Enter, check, and follow wholesale orders and customer data

Maintain Centra, Shopify, and operational files according to defined controls

Update ClickUp tasks, SOPs, and service-level trackers

2. 3PL & Logistics Coordination

Follow up with Sales, Finance, and logistics partners until issues close

Collect evidence for live-order and quality i

3. Communication & Escalation

Follow up on open items and escalate exceptions early with the facts needed for a decision

Join short voice calls when an issue cannot be resolved accurately in writing

Produce a clean weekly open-items report with clear owners and deadlines



Required Skills & Experience

Experience: 1–3 years in operations, supply chain, wholesale customer service, e-commerce, or an equivalent high-detail environment

Systems: Strong spreadsheet and system discipline; ERP or e-commerce experience is useful; familiarity with Centra, Shopify, or ClickUp is a plus

Communication: Clear spoken and written English; Italian, German, French, or Spanish is a useful plus

Availability: Reliable coverage of an agreed European shift

Profile: Accurate, reliable, and proactive — takes full ownership of tasks, prioritizes well, and knows what to solve independently vs. what to escalate early



How Success Is Measured

Quarterly variable pay (up to 5%) depends on order and data accuracy, response and closure SLAs, clean ClickUp handoffs, and early escalation of risks. Ticket volume alone is not a performance result.

title: Senior AI Automation engineer-E commerce AI agents
description:
We are building an AI automation company that creates and deploys custom AI agents for e-commerce businesses.



We are looking for a highly skilled AI Automation Engineer who can help us design and build the technical infrastructure behind these systems.



This is NOT a basic chatbot position.



This is NOT a prompt-engineering-only position.

We need someone who can take a business problem, design the technical architecture, build the automation, connect the required platforms, test the system, deploy it, monitor it, and improve it over time.

The ideal candidate is both a developer and a systems thinker.

You should be able to take an idea and turn it into a reliable, scalable AI-powered workflow that can eventually be duplicated and customized across multiple client businesses.

What You Will Help Build

Own end-to-end order processing and fulfillment across retail and wholesale customers

Review orders for quantities, pricing, ship dates, delivery requirements, and other key details; verify against finished goods inventory to confirm sufficient stock and shelf life

Support supply and demand planning using historical sales, retailer forecasts, and upcoming production requirements

Maintain clear operational trackers, SOPs, and reporting across orders, inventory, freight, and outstanding issues



Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 3+ years in CPG operations, supply chain, order management, logistics, or a related role; previous experience within food, beverage, grocery, or another physical CPG category is strongly preferred

Order Management: Hands-on experience processing purchase orders and coordinating fulfillment; experience working with 3PLs, warehouses, freight providers, distributors, and retailers

Inventory: Strong inventory management and reconciliation skills; experience reviewing BOLs, shipping documentation, and lot-level inventory

Systems: Experience working in SPS Commerce; strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

Communication: Excellent written and spoken English

Profile: Exceptional attention to detail, highly reliable, organized, and responsive; able to manage time-sensitive operational issues and follow tasks through to completion; proactive in identifying discrepancies and escalating issues when required

ROLE OVERVIEW

Your job is to find creators, brands, games, and online communities that could realistically become successful plush products.

We are specifically looking for creators with:

- recognizable mascots, avatars, characters, creatures, memes, or visual identities

The most important question is:



“Would fans realistically buy this as a plush product?”

========================================



A good lead MUST meet these requirements:



- Creator must be ACTIVE

(no dead channels or long upload breaks)



- Creator/community must be large enough that selling ~200 plush units is realistically possible



- Creator should currently NOT already sell plush merchandise



- Creator must have a mascot, avatar, inside joke, character, meme, creature, or visual identity that could realistically become a strong plush product





We are NOT looking for:

- generic influencers with no recognizable visual identity

- inactive creators

- tiny communities with no buying potential

- random gaming creators with no mascot/character potential





========================================

RESPONSIBILITIES

========================================



- Research creators, brands, games, and communities

- Find strong plush collaboration opportunities

- Collect contact details/socials

- Organize findings clearly





========================================

REQUIREMENTS

========================================



- Good internet research skills

- Understanding of online communities and creator culture

- Attention to detail

- Good English





========================================

WORK DETAILS

========================================



- 4 hours per day

- Flexible schedule





========================================

HOW TO APPLY

========================================



Please include:



1. Short introduction

2. Relevant experience

3. Contact information 
 etc.)



IMPORTANT:

Please include 3 SAMPLE LEADS you personally researched.



For EACH sample lead include:



- Who they are

- Links/socials

- WHAT specifically could become the plush

- WHY fans would likely buy it

- WHY the community is a strong fit



Weak answers:

“Big creator”, “gaming audience”, “popular community”



Strong answers:

Specific mascot/avatar/character ideas with clear collectible and fandom appeal.
